Exod 2:4 ב: to wit what would be done to him.
Exod 2:5 א: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash [herself] at the river;
Exod 2:5 ב: and her maidens walked along by the river’s side;
Exod 2:5 ג: and when she saw the ark among the flags,
Exod 2:5 ד: she sent her maid to fetch it.
Exod 2:6 א: And when she had opened [it], she saw the child:
Exod 2:6 ב: and, behold, the babe wept.
Exod 2:6 ג: And she had compassion on him, and said,
Exod 2:6 ד: This [is one] of the Hebrews’ children.
Exod 2:7 א: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter,
Exod 2:7 ב: Shall I go and call to thee
Exod 2:7 ג: a nurse of the Hebrew women,
Exod 2:7 ד: that she may nurse the child for thee?
Exod 2:8 א: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her,
Exod 2:8 ב: Go.
Exod 2:8 ג: And the maid went
Exod 2:8 ד: and called the child’s mother.
Exod 2:9 א: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her,
Exod 2:9 ב: Take this child away,
Exod 2:9 ג: and nurse it for me,
Exod 2:9 ד: and I will give [thee] thy wages.
Exod 2:9 ה: And the woman took the child,
Exod 2:9 ו: and nursed it.
Exod 2:10 א: And the child grew,
Exod 2:10 ב: and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter,
Exod 2:10 ג: and he became her son.
Exod 2:10 ד: And she called his name Moses: and she said,
Exod 2:10 ה: Because I drew him out of the water.
Exod 2:11 א: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown,
Exod 2:11 ב: that he went out unto his brethren,
Exod 2:11 ג: and looked on their burdens:
Exod 2:11 ד: and he spied an Egyptian
Exod 2:11 ה: smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
Exod 2:12 א: And he looked this way and that way,
Exod 2:12 ב: and when he saw that [there was] no man,
Exod 2:12 ג: he slew the Egyptian,
Exod 2:12 ד: and hid him in the sand.
Exod 2:13 א: And when he went out the second day, behold,
Exod 2:13 ב: two men of the Hebrews strove together:
Exod 2:13 ג: and he said to him that did the wrong,
Exod 2:13 ד: Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
Exod 2:14 א: And he said,
Exod 2:14 ב: Who made thee a prince
Exod 2:14 ג: and a judge over us?
Exod 2:14 ד: intendest thou to kill me,
Exod 2:14 ה: as thou killedst the Egyptian?
Exod 2:14 ו: And Moses feared, and said,
Exod 2:14 ז: Surely this thing is known.
Exod 2:15 א: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing,
Exod 2:15 ב: he sought to slay Moses.
Exod 2:15 ג: But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh,
Exod 2:15 ד: and dwelt in the land of Midian:
Exod 2:15 ה: and he sat down by a well.
Exod 2:16 א: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters:
Exod 2:16 ב: and they came and drew [water], and filled the troughs
Exod 2:16 ג: to water their father’s flock.
Exod 2:17 א: And the shepherds came and drove them away:
Exod 2:17 ב: but Moses stood up and helped them,
Exod 2:17 ג: and watered their flock.
Exod 2:18 א: And when they came to Reuel their father,
Exod 2:18 ב: he said,
Exod 2:18 ג: How [is it that] ye are come so soon to day?
Exod 2:19 א: And they said, An Egyptian
Exod 2:19 ב: delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds,
Exod 2:19 ג: and also drew [water] enough for us,
Exod 2:19 ד: and watered the flock.
Exod 2:20 א: And he said unto his daughters, And where [is] he?
Exod 2:20 ב: why [is] it [that] ye have left the man?
Exod 2:20 ג: call him, that he may eat bread.
Exod 2:21 א: And Moses was content to dwell with the man:
Exod 2:21 ב: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
Exod 2:22 א: And she bare [him] a son,
Exod 2:22 ב: and he called his name Gershom:
Exod 2:22 ג: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
Exod 2:23 א: And it came to pass in process of time,
Exod 2:23 ב: that the king of Egypt died:
Exod 2:23 ג: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage,
Exod 2:23 ד: and they cried,
Exod 2:23 ה: and their cry came up unto God
Exod 2:23 ו: by reason of the bondage.
Exod 2:24 א: And God heard their groaning,
Exod 2:24 ב: and God remembered his covenant
Exod 2:24 ג: with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
Exod 2:25 א: And God looked upon the children of Israel,
Exod 2:25 ב: and God had respect unto [them].
Exod 3:1 א: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro
Exod 3:1 ב: his father in law, the priest of Midian:
Exod 3:1 ג: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert,
Exod 3:1 ד: and came to the mountain of God,
Exod 3:1 ה: [even] to Horeb.
Exod 3:2 א: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him
Exod 3:2 ב: in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush:
Exod 3:2 ג: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire,
Exod 3:2 ד: and the bush [was] not consumed.
Exod 3:3 א: And Moses said,
Exod 3:3 ב: I will now turn aside,
Exod 3:3 ג: and see this great sight,
Exod 3:3 ד: why the bush is not burnt.
Exod 3:4 א: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see,
Exod 3:4 ב: God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said,
Exod 3:4 ג: Moses, Moses.
Exod 3:4 ד: And he said, Here [am] I.
Exod 3:5 א: And he said, Draw not nigh hither:
Exod 3:5 ב: put off thy shoes from off thy feet,
Exod 3:5 ג: for the place whereon thou standest
Exod 3:5 ד: [is] holy ground.
Exod 3:6 א: Moreover he said, I [am] the God of thy father,
Exod 3:6 ב: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
Exod 3:6 ג: And Moses hid his face;
Exod 3:6 ד: for he was afraid to look upon God.
Exod 3:7 א: And the LORD said,
Exod 3:7 ב: I have surely seen the affliction of my people which [are] in Egypt,
Exod 3:7 ג: and have heard their cry
Exod 3:7 ד: by reason of their taskmasters;
Exod 3:7 ה: for I know their sorrows;
Exod 3:8 א: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians,
Exod 3:8 ב: and to bring them up out of that land
Exod 3:8 ג: unto a good land and a large,
Exod 3:8 ד: unto a land flowing with milk and honey;
Exod 3:8 ה: unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
Exod 3:9 א: Now therefore, behold,
Exod 3:9 ב: the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me:
Exod 3:9 ג: and I have also seen the oppression
Exod 3:9 ד: wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
Exod 3:10 א: Come now therefore,
Exod 3:10 ב: and I will send thee unto Pharaoh,
Exod 3:10 ג: that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
Exod 3:11 א: And Moses said unto God,
Exod 3:11 ב: Who [am] I, that I should go unto Pharaoh,
Exod 3:11 ג: and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
Exod 3:12 א: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee;
Exod 3:12 ב: and this [shall be] a token unto thee, that I have sent thee:
Exod 3:12 ג: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt,
Exod 3:12 ד: ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
Exod 3:13 א: And Moses said unto God,
Exod 3:13 ב: Behold, [when] I come unto the children of Israel,
Exod 3:13 ג: and shall say unto them,
Exod 3:13 ד: The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you;
Exod 3:13 ה: and they shall say to me, What [is] his name?
Exod 3:13 ו: what shall I say unto them?
Exod 3:14 א: And God said unto Moses,
Exod 3:14 ב: I AM THAT I AM:
Exod 3:14 ג: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel,
Exod 3:14 ד: I AM hath sent me unto you.
Exod 3:15 א: And God said moreover unto Moses,
Exod 3:15 ב: Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel,
Exod 3:15 ג: The LORD God of your fathers,
Exod 3:15 ד: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob,
Exod 3:15 ה: hath sent me unto you:
Exod 3:15 ו: this [is] my name for ever,
Exod 3:15 ז: and this [is] my memorial unto all generations.
Exod 3:16 א: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together,
Exod 3:16 ב: and say unto them,
Exod 3:16 ג: The LORD God of your fathers, [...] appeared unto me,
Exod 3:16 ד: the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, [...] saying,
Exod 3:16 ה: I have surely visited you,
Exod 3:16 ו: and [seen] that which is done to you in Egypt:
Exod 3:17 א: And I have said,
Exod 3:17 ב: I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt
Exod 3:17 ג: unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites,
Exod 3:17 ד: unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
Exod 3:18 א: And they shall hearken to thy voice:
Exod 3:18 ב: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel,
Exod 3:18 ג: unto the king of Egypt,
Exod 3:18 ד: and ye shall say unto him,
Exod 3:18 ה: The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us:
Exod 3:18 ו: and now let us go, we beseech thee,
Exod 3:18 ז: three days’ journey into the wilderness,
Exod 3:18 ח: that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.
Exod 3:19 א: And I am sure
Exod 3:19 ב: that [...] will not let you
Exod 3:19 ג: the king of Egypt [...] go,
Exod 3:19 ד: no, not by a mighty hand.
Exod 3:20 א: And I will stretch out my hand,
Exod 3:20 ב: and smite Egypt
Exod 3:20 ג: with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof:
Exod 3:20 ד: and after that he will let you go.
Exod 3:21 א: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians:
Exod 3:21 ב: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go,
Exod 3:21 ג: ye shall not go empty:
Exod 3:22 א: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house,
Exod 3:22 ב: jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
Exod 3:22 ג: and ye shall put [them] upon your sons, and upon your daughters;
Exod 3:22 ד: and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
Exod 4:1 א: And Moses answered and said,
Exod 4:1 ב: But, behold, they will not believe me,
Exod 4:1 ג: nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say,
Exod 4:1 ד: The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.
Exod 4:2 א: And the LORD said unto him,
Exod 4:2 ב: What [is] that in thine hand?
Exod 4:2 ג: And he said, A rod.
Exod 4:3 א: And he said, Cast it on the ground.
Exod 4:3 ב: And he cast it on the ground,
Exod 4:3 ג: and it became a serpent;
Exod 4:3 ד: and Moses fled from before it.
Exod 4:4 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 4:4 ב: Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail.
Exod 4:4 ג: And he put forth his hand, and caught it,
Exod 4:4 ד: and it became a rod in his hand:
Exod 4:5 א: That they may believe
Exod 4:5 ב: that the LORD God of their fathers, [...] hath appeared unto thee.
Exod 4:5 ג: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob,
Exod 4:6 א: And the LORD said [...] unto him,
Exod 4:6 ב: furthermore [...] Put now thine hand into thy bosom.
Exod 4:6 ג: And he put his hand into his bosom:
Exod 4:6 ד: and when he took it out, behold,
Exod 4:6 ה: his hand [was] leprous as snow.
Exod 4:7 א: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again.
Exod 4:7 ב: And he put his hand into his bosom again;
Exod 4:7 ג: and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold,
Exod 4:7 ד: it was turned again as his [other] flesh.
Exod 4:8 א: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee,
Exod 4:8 ב: neither hearken to the voice of the first sign,
Exod 4:8 ג: that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
Exod 4:9 א: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also
Exod 4:9 ב: these two signs,
Exod 4:9 ג: neither hearken unto thy voice,
Exod 4:9 ד: that thou shalt take of the water of the river,
Exod 4:9 ה: and pour [it] upon the dry [land]:
Exod 4:9 ו: and the water which thou takest out of the river
Exod 4:9 ז: shall become blood upon the dry [land].
Exod 4:10 א: And Moses said unto the LORD,
Exod 4:10 ב: O my Lord,
Exod 4:10 ג: I [am] not eloquent,
Exod 4:10 ד: neither heretofore,
Exod 4:10 ה: nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant:
Exod 4:10 ו: but I [am] slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
Exod 4:11 א: And the LORD said unto him,
Exod 4:11 ב: Who hath made man’s mouth?
Exod 4:11 ג: or who maketh the dumb,
Exod 4:11 ד: or deaf,
Exod 4:11 ה: or the seeing,
Exod 4:11 ו: or the blind?
Exod 4:11 ז: have not I the LORD?
Exod 4:12 א: Now therefore go,
Exod 4:12 ב: and I will be with thy mouth,
Exod 4:12 ג: and teach thee what thou shalt say.
Exod 4:13 א: And he said, O my Lord,
Exod 4:13 ב: send, I pray thee, by the hand [of him whom] thou wilt send.
Exod 4:14 א: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said,
Exod 4:14 ב: [Is] not Aaron the Levite thy brother?
Exod 4:14 ג: I know that he can speak well.
Exod 4:14 ד: And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee:
Exod 4:14 ה: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
Exod 4:15 א: And thou shalt speak unto him,
Exod 4:15 ב: and put words in his mouth:
Exod 4:15 ג: and I will be with thy mouth,
Exod 4:15 ד: and with his mouth,
Exod 4:15 ה: and will teach you what ye shall do.
Exod 4:16 א: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people:
Exod 4:16 ב: and he shall be, [even] he shall be to thee instead of a mouth,
Exod 4:16 ג: and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
Exod 4:17 א: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand,
Exod 4:17 ב: wherewith thou shalt do signs.
Exod 4:18 א: And Moses went
Exod 4:18 ב: and returned to Jethro his father in law,
Exod 4:18 ג: and said unto him,
Exod 4:18 ד: Let me go, I pray thee,
Exod 4:18 ה: and return unto my brethren which [are] in Egypt,
Exod 4:18 ו: and see whether they be yet alive.
Exod 4:18 ז: And Jethro said to Moses,
Exod 4:18 ח: Go in peace.
Exod 4:19 א: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian,
Exod 4:19 ב: Go,
Exod 4:19 ג: return into Egypt:
Exod 4:19 ד: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.
Exod 4:20 א: And Moses took his wife and his sons,
Exod 4:20 ב: and set them upon an ass,
Exod 4:20 ג: and he returned to the land of Egypt:
Exod 4:20 ד: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
Exod 4:21 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 4:21 ב: When thou goest to return into Egypt,
Exod 4:21 ג: see [...] all those wonders [...] which I have put in thine hand:
Exod 4:21 ד: that thou do [...] before Pharaoh,
Exod 4:21 ה: but I will harden his heart,
Exod 4:21 ו: that he shall not let the people go.
Exod 4:22 א: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh,
Exod 4:22 ב: Thus saith the LORD,
Exod 4:22 ג: Israel [is] my son, [even] my firstborn:
Exod 4:23 א: And I say unto thee,
Exod 4:23 ב: Let my son go, that he may serve me:
Exod 4:23 ג: and if thou refuse to let him go,
Exod 4:23 ד: behold,
Exod 4:23 ה: I will slay thy son, [even] thy firstborn.
Exod 4:24 א: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him,
Exod 4:24 ב: and sought to kill him.
Exod 4:25 א: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone,
Exod 4:25 ב: and cut off the foreskin of her son,
Exod 4:25 ג: and cast [it] at his feet, and said,
Exod 4:25 ד: Surely a bloody husband [art] thou to me.
Exod 4:26 א: So he let him go: then she said,
Exod 4:26 ב: A bloody husband [thou art],
Exod 4:26 ג: because of the circumcision.
Exod 4:27 א: And the LORD said to Aaron,
Exod 4:27 ב: Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.
Exod 4:27 ג: And he went, and met him in the mount of God,
Exod 4:27 ד: and kissed him.
Exod 4:28 א: And Moses told Aaron
Exod 4:28 ב: all the words of the LORD who had sent him,
Exod 4:28 ג: and all the signs which he had commanded him.
Exod 4:29 א: And Moses and Aaron went
Exod 4:29 ב: and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
Exod 4:30 א: And Aaron spake all the words
Exod 4:30 ב: which the LORD had spoken unto Moses,
Exod 4:30 ג: and did the signs in the sight of the people.
Exod 4:31 א: And the people believed: and when they heard
Exod 4:31 ב: that the LORD had visited the children of Israel,
Exod 4:31 ג: and that he had looked upon their affliction,
Exod 4:31 ד: then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
Exod 5:1 א: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in,
Exod 5:1 ב: and told Pharaoh,
Exod 5:1 ג: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel,
Exod 5:1 ד: Let my people go,
Exod 5:1 ה: that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
Exod 5:2 א: And Pharaoh said,
Exod 5:2 ב: Who [is] the LORD, that I should obey his voice
Exod 5:2 ג: to let Israel go?
Exod 5:2 ד: I know not the LORD,
Exod 5:2 ה: neither will I let Israel go.
Exod 5:3 א: And they said,
Exod 5:3 ב: The God of the Hebrews hath met with us:
Exod 5:3 ג: let us go, we pray thee, three days’ journey into the desert,
Exod 5:3 ד: and sacrifice unto the LORD our God;
Exod 5:3 ה: lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
Exod 5:4 א: And the king of Egypt said unto them,
Exod 5:4 ב: Wherefore [...] Moses and Aaron,
Exod 5:4 ג: do ye, [...] let the people from their works?
Exod 5:4 ד: get you unto your burdens.
Exod 5:5 א: And Pharaoh said,
Exod 5:5 ב: Behold, the people of the land now [are] many,
Exod 5:5 ג: and ye make them rest from their burdens.
Exod 5:6 א: And Pharaoh commanded the same day
Exod 5:6 ב: the taskmasters of the people,
Exod 5:6 ג: and their officers, saying,
Exod 5:7 א: Ye shall no more give the people straw
Exod 5:7 ב: to make brick, as heretofore:
Exod 5:7 ג: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
Exod 5:8 א: And the tale of the bricks,
Exod 5:8 ב: which they did make heretofore,
Exod 5:8 ג: ye shall lay upon them;
Exod 5:8 ד: ye shall not diminish [ought] thereof:
Exod 5:8 ה: for they [be] idle;
Exod 5:8 ו: therefore they cry, saying,
Exod 5:8 ז: Let us go [and] sacrifice to our God.
Exod 5:9 א: Let there more work be laid upon the men,
Exod 5:9 ב: that they may labour therein;
Exod 5:9 ג: and let them not regard vain words.
Exod 5:10 א: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers,
Exod 5:10 ב: and they spake to the people, saying,
Exod 5:10 ג: Thus saith Pharaoh,
Exod 5:10 ד: I will not give you straw.
Exod 5:11 א: Go ye,
Exod 5:11 ב: get you straw where ye can find it:
Exod 5:11 ג: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
Exod 5:12 א: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt
Exod 5:12 ב: to gather stubble instead of straw.
Exod 5:13 א: And the taskmasters hasted [them], saying,
Exod 5:13 ב: Fulfil your works, [your] daily tasks,
Exod 5:13 ג: as when there was straw.
Exod 5:14 א: And [...] were beaten,
Exod 5:14 ב: the officers of the children of Israel,
Exod 5:14 ג: which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them,
Exod 5:14 ד: [and] demanded,
Exod 5:14 ה: Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task
Exod 5:14 ו: in making brick [...] as heretofore?
Exod 5:14 ז: both yesterday and to day,
Exod 5:15 א: Then the officers of the children of Israel came
Exod 5:15 ב: and cried unto Pharaoh, saying,
Exod 5:15 ג: Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
Exod 5:16 א: There is no straw given unto thy servants,
Exod 5:16 ב: and they say to us, Make brick:
Exod 5:16 ג: and, behold, thy servants [are] beaten;
Exod 5:16 ד: but the fault [is] in thine own people.
Exod 5:17 א: But he said, Ye [are] idle,
Exod 5:17 ב: [ye are] idle: therefore ye say,
Exod 5:17 ג: Let us go [and] do sacrifice to the LORD.
Exod 5:18 א: Go therefore now,
Exod 5:18 ב: [and] work;
Exod 5:18 ג: for there shall no straw be given you,
Exod 5:18 ד: yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
Exod 5:19 א: And the officers of the children of Israel did see [that]
Exod 5:19 ב: they [were] in evil [case], after it was said,
Exod 5:19 ג: Ye shall not minish [ought] from your bricks
Exod 5:19 ד: of your daily task.
Exod 5:20 א: And they met Moses and Aaron,
Exod 5:20 ב: who stood in the way,
Exod 5:20 ג: as they came forth from Pharaoh:
Exod 5:21 א: And they said unto them,
Exod 5:21 ב: The LORD look upon you,
Exod 5:21 ג: and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh,
Exod 5:21 ד: and in the eyes of his servants,
Exod 5:21 ה: to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
Exod 5:22 א: And Moses returned unto the LORD,
Exod 5:22 ב: and said, Lord,
Exod 5:22 ג: wherefore hast thou [so] evil entreated this people?
Exod 5:22 ד: why [is] it [that] thou hast sent me?
Exod 5:23 א: For since I came to Pharaoh
Exod 5:23 ב: to speak in thy name,
Exod 5:23 ג: he hath done evil to this people;
Exod 5:23 ד: neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
Exod 6:1 א: Then the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 6:1 ב: Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh:
Exod 6:1 ג: for with a strong hand shall he let them go,
Exod 6:1 ד: and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
Exod 6:2 א: And God spake unto Moses,
Exod 6:2 ב: and said unto him,
Exod 6:2 ג: I [am] the LORD:
Exod 6:3 א: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob,
Exod 6:3 ב: by [the name of] God Almighty,
Exod 6:3 ג: but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
Exod 6:4 א: And I have also established my covenant with them,
Exod 6:4 ב: to give them the land of Canaan,
Exod 6:4 ג: the land of their pilgrimage,
Exod 6:4 ד: wherein they were strangers.
Exod 6:5 א: And I [...] also
Exod 6:5 ב: have [...] heard the groaning of the children of Israel,
Exod 6:5 ג: whom the Egyptians keep in bondage;
Exod 6:5 ד: and I have remembered my covenant.
Exod 6:6 א: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel,
Exod 6:6 ב: I [am] the LORD,
Exod 6:6 ג: and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians,
Exod 6:6 ד: and I will rid you out of their bondage,
Exod 6:6 ה: and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm,
Exod 6:6 ו: and with great judgments:
Exod 6:7 א: And I will take you to me for a people,
Exod 6:7 ב: and I will be to you a God:
Exod 6:7 ג: and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD your God,
Exod 6:7 ד: which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
Exod 6:8 א: And I will bring you in unto the land,
Exod 6:8 ב: concerning the which I did swear
Exod 6:8 ג: to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob;
Exod 6:8 ד: and I will give it you for an heritage:
Exod 6:8 ה: I [am] the LORD.
Exod 6:9 א: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel:
Exod 6:9 ב: but they hearkened not unto Moses
Exod 6:9 ג: for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
Exod 6:10 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Exod 6:11 א: Go in,
Exod 6:11 ב: speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt,
Exod 6:11 ג: that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
Exod 6:12 א: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying,
Exod 6:12 ב: Behold, the children of Israel
Exod 6:12 ג: have not hearkened unto me;
Exod 6:12 ד: how then shall Pharaoh hear me,
Exod 6:12 ה: who [am] of uncircumcised lips?
Exod 6:13 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron,
Exod 6:13 ב: and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel,
Exod 6:13 ג: and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt,
Exod 6:13 ד: to bring the children of Israel
Exod 6:13 ה: out of the land of Egypt.
Exod 6:14 א: These [be] the heads of their fathers’ houses:
Exod 6:14 ב: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel;
Exod 6:14 ג: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi:
Exod 6:14 ד: these [be] the families of Reuben.
Exod 6:15 א: And the sons of Simeon;
Exod 6:15 ב: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul
Exod 6:15 ג: the son of a Canaanitish woman:
Exod 6:15 ד: these [are] the families of Simeon.
Exod 6:16 א: And these [are] the names of the sons of Levi
Exod 6:16 ב: according to their generations;
Exod 6:16 ג: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari:
Exod 6:16 ד: and the years of the life of Levi
Exod 6:16 ה: [were] an hundred thirty and seven years.
Exod 6:17 א: The sons of Gershon;
Exod 6:17 ב: Libni, and Shimi,
Exod 6:17 ג: according to their families.
Exod 6:18 א: And the sons of Kohath;
Exod 6:18 ב: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel:
Exod 6:18 ג: and the years of the life of Kohath
Exod 6:18 ד: [were] an hundred thirty and three years.
Exod 6:19 א: And the sons of Merari;
Exod 6:19 ב: Mahali and Mushi:
Exod 6:19 ג: these [are] the families of Levi according to their generations.
Exod 6:20 א: And Amram took him Jochebed
Exod 6:20 ב: his father’s sister
Exod 6:20 ג: to wife;
Exod 6:20 ד: and she bare him Aaron and Moses:
Exod 6:20 ה: and the years of the life of Amram
Exod 6:20 ו: [were] an hundred and thirty and seven years.
Exod 6:21 א: And the sons of Izhar;
Exod 6:21 ב: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
Exod 6:22 א: And the sons of Uzziel;
Exod 6:22 ב: Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
Exod 6:23 א: And Aaron took him Elisheba,
Exod 6:23 ב: daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon,
Exod 6:23 ג: to wife;
Exod 6:23 ד: and she bare him Nadab,
Exod 6:23 ה: and Abihu,
Exod 6:23 ו: Eleazar,
Exod 6:23 ז: and Ithamar.
Exod 6:24 א: And the sons of Korah;
Exod 6:24 ב: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph:
Exod 6:24 ג: these [are] the families of the Korhites.
Exod 6:25 א: And Eleazar Aaron’s son
Exod 6:25 ב: took him [one] of the daughters of Putiel
Exod 6:25 ג: to wife;
Exod 6:25 ד: and she bare him Phinehas:
Exod 6:25 ה: these [are] the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
Exod 6:26 א: These [are] [...] Aaron and Moses,
Exod 6:26 ב: that [...] to whom the LORD said,
Exod 6:26 ג: Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt
Exod 6:26 ד: according to their armies.
Exod 6:27 א: These [are] they which spake to Pharaoh
Exod 6:27 ב: king of Egypt,
Exod 6:27 ג: to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt:
Exod 6:27 ד: these [are] that Moses and Aaron.
Exod 6:28 א: And it came to pass on the day [when] the LORD spake
Exod 6:28 ב: unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
Exod 6:29 א: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Exod 6:29 ב: I [am] the LORD:
Exod 6:29 ג: speak thou unto Pharaoh
Exod 6:29 ד: king of Egypt
Exod 6:29 ה: all that I say unto thee.
Exod 6:30 א: And Moses said before the LORD,
Exod 6:30 ב: Behold, I [am] of uncircumcised lips,
Exod 6:30 ג: and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
Exod 7:1 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 7:1 ב: See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh:
Exod 7:1 ג: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
Exod 7:2 א: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee:
Exod 7:2 ב: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh,
Exod 7:2 ג: that he send the children of Israel out of his land.
Exod 7:3 א: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart,
Exod 7:3 ב: and multiply my signs
Exod 7:3 ג: and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
Exod 7:4 א: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you,
Exod 7:4 ב: that I may lay my hand upon Egypt,
Exod 7:4 ג: and bring forth mine armies,
Exod 7:4 ד: [and] my people the children of Israel,
Exod 7:4 ה: out of the land of Egypt
Exod 7:4 ו: by great judgments.
Exod 7:5 א: And the Egyptians shall know that I [am] the LORD,
Exod 7:5 ב: when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt,
Exod 7:5 ג: and bring out the children of Israel from among them.
Exod 7:6 א: And Moses and Aaron did
Exod 7:6 ב: as the LORD commanded them,
Exod 7:6 ג: so did they.
Exod 7:7 א: And Moses [was] fourscore years old,
Exod 7:7 ב: and Aaron fourscore and three years old,
Exod 7:7 ג: when they spake unto Pharaoh.
Exod 7:8 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses
Exod 7:8 ב: and unto Aaron, saying,
Exod 7:9 א: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying,
Exod 7:9 ב: Shew a miracle for you:
Exod 7:9 ג: then thou shalt say unto Aaron,
Exod 7:9 ד: Take thy rod, and cast [it] before Pharaoh,
Exod 7:9 ה: [and] it shall become a serpent.
Exod 7:10 א: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh,
Exod 7:10 ב: and they did so as the LORD had commanded:
Exod 7:10 ג: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh,
Exod 7:10 ד: and before his servants,
Exod 7:10 ה: and it became a serpent.
Exod 7:11 א: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers:
Exod 7:11 ב: now [...] they also did
Exod 7:11 ג: the magicians of Egypt,
Exod 7:11 ד: in like manner with their enchantments.
Exod 7:12 א: For they cast down every man his rod,
Exod 7:12 ב: and they became serpents:
Exod 7:12 ג: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
Exod 7:13 א: And he hardened Pharaoh’s heart,
Exod 7:13 ב: that he hearkened not unto them;
Exod 7:13 ג: as the LORD had said.
Exod 7:14 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 7:14 ב: Pharaoh’s heart [is] hardened,
Exod 7:14 ג: he refuseth to let the people go.
Exod 7:15 א: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning;
Exod 7:15 ב: lo, he goeth out unto the water;
Exod 7:15 ג: and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink against he come;
Exod 7:15 ד: and the rod which was turned to a serpent
Exod 7:15 ה: shalt thou take in thine hand.
Exod 7:16 א: And thou shalt say unto him,
Exod 7:16 ב: The LORD God of the Hebrews
Exod 7:16 ג: hath sent me unto thee, saying,
Exod 7:16 ד: Let my people go,
Exod 7:16 ה: that they may serve me in the wilderness:
Exod 7:16 ו: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.
Exod 7:17 א: Thus saith the LORD,
Exod 7:17 ב: In this thou shalt know that I [am] the LORD:
Exod 7:17 ג: behold, I will smite with the rod
Exod 7:17 ד: that [is] in mine hand
Exod 7:17 ה: upon the waters which [are] in the river,
Exod 7:17 ו: and they shall be turned to blood.
Exod 7:18 א: And the fish that [is] in the river shall die,
Exod 7:18 ב: and the river shall stink;
Exod 7:18 ג: and the Egyptians shall lothe
Exod 7:18 ד: to drink of the water of the river.
Exod 7:19 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses,
Exod 7:19 ב: Say unto Aaron,
Exod 7:19 ג: Take thy rod,
Exod 7:19 ד: and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt,
Exod 7:19 ה: upon their streams,
Exod 7:19 ו: upon their rivers,
Exod 7:19 ז: and upon their ponds,
Exod 7:19 ח: and upon all their pools of water,
Exod 7:19 ט: that they may become blood;
Exod 7:19 י: and [that] there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt,
Exod 7:19 כ: both in [vessels of] wood, and in [vessels of] stone.
Exod 7:20 א: And Moses and Aaron did so,
Exod 7:20 ב: as the LORD commanded;
Exod 7:20 ג: and he lifted up the rod,
Exod 7:20 ד: and smote the waters that [were] in the river,
Exod 7:20 ה: in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants;
Exod 7:20 ו: and all the waters that [were] in the river were turned to blood.
Exod 7:21 א: And the fish that [was] in the river died;
Exod 7:21 ב: and the river stank,
Exod 7:21 ג: and the Egyptians could not
Exod 7:21 ד: drink of the water of the river;
Exod 7:21 ה: and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
Exod 7:22 א: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments:
Exod 7:22 ב: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened,
Exod 7:22 ג: neither did he hearken unto them;
Exod 7:22 ד: as the LORD had said.
Exod 7:23 א: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house,
Exod 7:23 ב: neither did he set his heart to this also.
Exod 7:24 א: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river
Exod 7:24 ב: for water to drink;
Exod 7:24 ג: for they could not drink
Exod 7:24 ד: of the water of the river.
Exod 7:25 א: And seven days were fulfilled,
Exod 7:25 ב: after that the LORD had smitten the river.
Exod 8:1 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses,
Exod 8:1 ב: Go unto Pharaoh,
Exod 8:1 ג: and say unto him,
Exod 8:1 ד: Thus saith the LORD,
Exod 8:1 ה: Let my people go,
Exod 8:1 ו: that they may serve me.
Exod 8:2 א: And if thou refuse to let [them] go,
Exod 8:2 ב: behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
Exod 8:3 א: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly,
Exod 8:3 ב: which shall go up and come into thine house,
Exod 8:3 ג: and into thy bedchamber,
Exod 8:3 ד: and upon thy bed,
Exod 8:3 ה: and into the house of thy servants,
Exod 8:3 ו: and upon thy people,
Exod 8:3 ז: and into thine ovens,
Exod 8:3 ח: and into thy kneadingtroughs:
Exod 8:4 א: And [...] both on thee,
Exod 8:4 ב: and upon thy people,
Exod 8:4 ג: and upon all thy servants.
Exod 8:4 ד: the frogs shall come up
Exod 8:5 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses,
Exod 8:5 ב: Say unto Aaron,
Exod 8:5 ג: Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod
Exod 8:5 ד: over the streams,
Exod 8:5 ה: over the rivers,
Exod 8:5 ו: and over the ponds,
Exod 8:5 ז: and cause frogs to come up
Exod 8:5 ח: upon the land of Egypt.
Exod 8:6 א: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt;
Exod 8:6 ב: and the frogs came up,
Exod 8:6 ג: and covered the land of Egypt.
Exod 8:7 א: And the magicians did so with their enchantments,
Exod 8:7 ב: and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
Exod 8:8 א: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said,
Exod 8:8 ב: Intreat the LORD,
Exod 8:8 ג: that he may take away the frogs from me,
Exod 8:8 ד: and from my people;
Exod 8:8 ה: and I will let the people go,
Exod 8:8 ו: that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD.
Exod 8:9 א: And Moses said unto Pharaoh,
Exod 8:9 ב: Glory over me:
Exod 8:9 ג: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people,
Exod 8:9 ד: to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses,
Exod 8:9 ה: [that] they may remain in the river only?
Exod 8:10 א: And he said, To morrow.
Exod 8:10 ב: And he said, [Be it] according to thy word:
Exod 8:10 ג: that thou mayest know that [there is] none like unto the LORD our God.
Exod 8:11 א: And the frogs shall depart from thee,
Exod 8:11 ב: and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people;
Exod 8:11 ג: they shall remain in the river only.
Exod 8:12 א: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh:
Exod 8:12 ב: and Moses cried unto the LORD
Exod 8:12 ג: because of the frogs
Exod 8:12 ד: which he had brought against Pharaoh.
Exod 8:13 א: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses;
Exod 8:13 ב: and the frogs died
Exod 8:13 ג: out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.
Exod 8:14 א: And they gathered them together upon heaps:
Exod 8:14 ב: and the land stank.
Exod 8:15 א: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite,
Exod 8:15 ב: he hardened his heart,
Exod 8:15 ג: and hearkened not unto them;
Exod 8:15 ד: as the LORD had said.
Exod 8:16 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 8:16 ב: Say unto Aaron,
Exod 8:16 ג: Stretch out thy rod,
Exod 8:16 ד: and smite the dust of the land,
Exod 8:16 ה: that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
Exod 8:17 א: And they did so;
Exod 8:17 ב: for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod,
Exod 8:17 ג: and smote the dust of the earth,
Exod 8:17 ד: and it became lice in man, and in beast;
Exod 8:17 ה: all the dust of the land became lice
Exod 8:17 ו: throughout all the land of Egypt.
Exod 8:18 א: And the magicians did so with their enchantments
Exod 8:18 ב: to bring forth lice,
Exod 8:18 ג: but they could not:
Exod 8:18 ד: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.
Exod 8:19 א: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh,
Exod 8:19 ב: This [is] the finger of God:
Exod 8:19 ג: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened,
Exod 8:19 ד: and he hearkened not unto them;
Exod 8:19 ה: as the LORD had said.
Exod 8:20 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 8:20 ב: Rise up early in the morning,
Exod 8:20 ג: and stand before Pharaoh;
Exod 8:20 ד: lo, he cometh forth to the water;
Exod 8:20 ה: and say unto him,
Exod 8:20 ו: Thus saith the LORD,
Exod 8:20 ז: Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Exod 8:21 א: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go,
Exod 8:21 ב: behold, I will send [...] upon thee,
Exod 8:21 ג: and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses:
Exod 8:21 ד: swarms [of flies]
Exod 8:21 ה: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms [of flies],
Exod 8:21 ו: and also the ground whereon they [are].
Exod 8:22 א: And I will sever in that day
Exod 8:22 ב: the land of Goshen,
Exod 8:22 ג: in which my people dwell,
Exod 8:22 ד: that no swarms [of flies] shall be there;
Exod 8:22 ה: to the end thou mayest know that
Exod 8:22 ו: I [am] the LORD in the midst of the earth.
Exod 8:23 א: And I will put a division between my people and thy people:
Exod 8:23 ב: to morrow shall this sign be.
Exod 8:24 א: And the LORD did so;
Exod 8:24 ב: and there came a grievous swarm [of flies] into the house of Pharaoh,
Exod 8:24 ג: and [into] his servants’ houses,
Exod 8:24 ד: and into all the land of Egypt:
Exod 8:24 ה: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm [of flies].
Exod 8:25 א: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said,
Exod 8:25 ב: Go ye,
Exod 8:25 ג: sacrifice to your God in the land.
Exod 8:26 א: And Moses said,
Exod 8:26 ב: It is not meet so to do;
Exod 8:26 ג: for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God:
Exod 8:26 ד: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes,
Exod 8:26 ה: and will they not stone us?
Exod 8:27 א: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness,
Exod 8:27 ב: and sacrifice to the LORD our God,
Exod 8:27 ג: as he shall command us.
Exod 8:28 א: And Pharaoh said,
Exod 8:28 ב: I will let you go,
Exod 8:28 ג: that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness;
Exod 8:28 ד: only ye shall not go very far away:
Exod 8:28 ה: intreat for me.
Exod 8:29 א: And Moses said,
Exod 8:29 ב: Behold, I go out from thee,
Exod 8:29 ג: and I will intreat the LORD
Exod 8:29 ד: that the swarms [of flies] may depart from Pharaoh,
Exod 8:29 ה: from his servants, and from his people,
Exod 8:29 ו: to morrow:
Exod 8:29 ז: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more
Exod 8:29 ח: in not letting the people go
Exod 8:29 ט: to sacrifice to the LORD.
Exod 8:30 א: And Moses went out from Pharaoh,
Exod 8:30 ב: and intreated the LORD.
Exod 8:31 א: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses;
Exod 8:31 ב: and he removed the swarms [of flies] from Pharaoh,
Exod 8:31 ג: from his servants, and from his people;
Exod 8:31 ד: there remained not one.
Exod 8:32 א: And Pharaoh hardened his heart
Exod 8:32 ב: at this time also,
Exod 8:32 ג: neither would he let the people go.
Exod 9:1 א: Then the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 9:1 ב: Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him,
Exod 9:1 ג: Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews,
Exod 9:1 ד: Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Exod 9:2 א: For if thou refuse to let [them] go,
Exod 9:2 ב: and wilt hold them still,
Exod 9:3 א: Behold,
Exod 9:3 ב: the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which [is] in the field,
Exod 9:3 ג: upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep:
Exod 9:3 ד: [there shall be] a very grievous murrain.
Exod 9:4 א: And the LORD shall sever between the cattle of Israel
Exod 9:4 ב: and the cattle of Egypt:
Exod 9:4 ג: and there shall nothing die of all [that is] the children’s of Israel.
Exod 9:5 א: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying,
Exod 9:5 ב: To morrow the LORD shall do
Exod 9:5 ג: this thing in the land.
Exod 9:6 א: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow,
Exod 9:6 ב: and all the cattle of Egypt died:
Exod 9:6 ג: but of the cattle of the children of Israel
Exod 9:6 ד: died not one.
Exod 9:7 א: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold,
Exod 9:7 ב: there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead.
Exod 9:7 ג: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened,
Exod 9:7 ד: and he did not let the people go.
Exod 9:8 א: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron,
Exod 9:8 ב: Take to you handfuls
Exod 9:8 ג: of ashes of the furnace,
Exod 9:8 ד: and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven
Exod 9:8 ה: in the sight of Pharaoh.
Exod 9:9 א: And it shall become small dust
Exod 9:9 ב: in all the land of Egypt,
Exod 9:9 ג: and shall be [...] upon man,
Exod 9:9 ד: and upon beast,
Exod 9:9 ה: a boil breaking forth [with] blains
Exod 9:9 ו: throughout all the land of Egypt.
Exod 9:10 א: And they took ashes of the furnace,
Exod 9:10 ב: and stood before Pharaoh;
Exod 9:10 ג: and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven;
Exod 9:10 ד: and it became a boil breaking forth [with] blains
Exod 9:10 ה: upon man, and upon beast.
Exod 9:11 א: And the magicians could not
Exod 9:11 ב: stand before Moses
Exod 9:11 ג: because of the boils;
Exod 9:11 ד: for the boil was upon the magicians,
Exod 9:11 ה: and upon all the Egyptians.
Exod 9:12 א: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh,
Exod 9:12 ב: and he hearkened not unto them;
Exod 9:12 ג: as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.
Exod 9:13 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 9:13 ב: Rise up early in the morning,
Exod 9:13 ג: and stand before Pharaoh,
Exod 9:13 ד: and say unto him,
Exod 9:13 ה: Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews,
Exod 9:13 ו: Let my people go,
Exod 9:13 ז: that they may serve me.
Exod 9:14 א: For [...] at this time
Exod 9:14 ב: I will [...] send all my plagues upon thine heart,
Exod 9:14 ג: and upon thy servants, and upon thy people;
Exod 9:14 ד: that thou mayest know
Exod 9:14 ה: that [there is] none like me
Exod 9:14 ו: in all the earth.
Exod 9:15 א: For now I will stretch out my hand,
Exod 9:15 ב: that I may smite thee
Exod 9:15 ג: and thy people with pestilence;
Exod 9:15 ד: and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.
Exod 9:16 א: And in very deed for this [cause]
Exod 9:16 ב: have I raised thee up,
Exod 9:16 ג: for to shew [in] thee my power;
Exod 9:16 ד: and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
Exod 9:17 א: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people,
Exod 9:17 ב: that thou wilt not let them go?
Exod 9:18 א: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain
Exod 9:18 ב: a very grievous hail,
Exod 9:18 ג: such as hath not been in Egypt
Exod 9:18 ד: since the foundation thereof
Exod 9:18 ה: even until now.
Exod 9:19 א: Send therefore now,
Exod 9:19 ב: [and] gather thy cattle,
Exod 9:19 ג: and all that thou hast in the field;
Exod 9:19 ד: [for upon] every man and beast which shall be found in the field,
Exod 9:19 ה: and shall not be brought home,
Exod 9:19 ו: the hail shall come down upon them,
Exod 9:19 ז: and they shall die.
Exod 9:20 א: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh
Exod 9:20 ב: made his servants [...] flee
Exod 9:20 ג: and his cattle
Exod 9:20 ד: into the houses:
Exod 9:21 א: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD
Exod 9:21 ב: left his servants
Exod 9:21 ג: and his cattle
Exod 9:21 ד: in the field.
Exod 9:22 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 9:22 ב: Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven,
Exod 9:22 ג: that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt,
Exod 9:22 ד: upon man, and upon beast,
Exod 9:22 ה: and upon every herb of the field,
Exod 9:22 ו: throughout the land of Egypt.
Exod 9:23 א: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven:
Exod 9:23 ב: and the LORD sent thunder and hail,
Exod 9:23 ג: and the fire ran along upon the ground;
Exod 9:23 ד: and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
Exod 9:24 א: So there was hail,
Exod 9:24 ב: and fire mingled with the hail,
Exod 9:24 ג: very grievous,
Exod 9:24 ד: such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt
Exod 9:24 ה: since it became a nation.
Exod 9:25 א: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt
Exod 9:25 ב: all that [was] in the field,
Exod 9:25 ג: both man and beast;
Exod 9:25 ד: and [...] every herb of the field,
Exod 9:25 ה: the hail smote
Exod 9:25 ו: and brake every tree of the field.
Exod 9:26 א: Only in the land of Goshen,
Exod 9:26 ב: where the children of Israel [were],
Exod 9:26 ג: was there no hail.
Exod 9:27 א: And Pharaoh sent,
Exod 9:27 ב: and called for Moses and Aaron,
Exod 9:27 ג: and said unto them,
Exod 9:27 ד: I have sinned this time:
Exod 9:27 ה: the LORD [is] righteous,
Exod 9:27 ו: and I and my people [are] wicked.
Exod 9:28 א: Intreat the LORD
Exod 9:28 ב: (for [it is] enough) that there be no [more] mighty thunderings and hail;
Exod 9:28 ג: and I will let you go,
Exod 9:28 ד: and ye shall stay no longer.
Exod 9:29 א: And Moses said unto him,
Exod 9:29 ב: As soon as I am gone out of the city,
Exod 9:29 ג: I will spread abroad my hands unto the LORD;
Exod 9:29 ד: [and] the thunder shall cease,
