Exod 13:8 א: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying,
Exod 13:8 ב: [This is done] because of that [which] the LORD did unto me
Exod 13:8 ג: when I came forth out of Egypt.
Exod 13:9 א: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand,
Exod 13:9 ב: and for a memorial between thine eyes,
Exod 13:9 ג: that the LORD’S law may be in thy mouth:
Exod 13:9 ד: for with a strong hand
Exod 13:9 ה: hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.
Exod 13:10 א: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season
Exod 13:10 ב: from year to year.
Exod 13:11 א: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites,
Exod 13:11 ב: as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers,
Exod 13:11 ג: and shall give it thee,
Exod 13:12 א: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix,
Exod 13:12 ב: and every firstling that cometh of a beast
Exod 13:12 ג: which thou hast;
Exod 13:12 ד: the males [shall be] the LORD’S.
Exod 13:13 א: And every firstling of an ass
Exod 13:13 ב: thou shalt redeem with a lamb;
Exod 13:13 ג: and if thou wilt not redeem it,
Exod 13:13 ד: then thou shalt break his neck:
Exod 13:13 ה: and all the firstborn of man among thy children
Exod 13:13 ו: shalt thou redeem.
Exod 13:14 א: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying,
Exod 13:14 ב: What [is] this?
Exod 13:14 ג: that thou shalt say unto him,
Exod 13:14 ד: By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt,
Exod 13:14 ה: from the house of bondage:
Exod 13:15 א: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go,
Exod 13:15 ב: that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt,
Exod 13:15 ג: both the firstborn of man,
Exod 13:15 ד: and the firstborn of beast:
Exod 13:15 ה: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD
Exod 13:15 ו: all that openeth the matrix, being males;
Exod 13:15 ז: but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.
Exod 13:16 א: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand,
Exod 13:16 ב: and for frontlets between thine eyes:
Exod 13:16 ג: for by strength of hand
Exod 13:16 ד: the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.
Exod 13:17 א: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go,
Exod 13:17 ב: that God led them not
Exod 13:17 ג: [through] the way of the land of the Philistines,
Exod 13:17 ד: although that [was] near;
Exod 13:17 ה: for God said,
Exod 13:17 ו: Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war,
Exod 13:17 ז: and they return to Egypt:
Exod 13:18 א: But God led the people about,
Exod 13:18 ב: [through] the way of the wilderness of the Red sea:
Exod 13:18 ג: and the children of Israel went up harnessed
Exod 13:18 ד: out of the land of Egypt.
Exod 13:19 א: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him:
Exod 13:19 ב: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying,
Exod 13:19 ג: God will surely visit you;
Exod 13:19 ד: and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
Exod 13:20 א: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham,
Exod 13:20 ב: in the edge of the wilderness.
Exod 13:21 א: And the LORD went before them
Exod 13:21 ב: by day [...] of a cloud, [...] in a pillar
Exod 13:21 ג: to lead them the way;
Exod 13:21 ד: in a pillar [...] and by night [...] of fire,
Exod 13:21 ה: to give them light;
Exod 13:21 ו: to go by day and night:
Exod 13:22 א: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day,
Exod 13:22 ב: nor the pillar of fire by night,
Exod 13:22 ג: [from] before the people.
Exod 14:1 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Exod 14:2 א: Speak unto the children of Israel,
Exod 14:2 ב: that they turn and encamp before Pi–hahiroth,
Exod 14:2 ג: between Migdol and the sea,
Exod 14:2 ד: over against Baal–zephon: before it
Exod 14:2 ה: shall ye encamp by the sea.
Exod 14:3 א: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel,
Exod 14:3 ב: They [are] entangled in the land,
Exod 14:3 ג: the wilderness hath shut them in.
Exod 14:4 א: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart,
Exod 14:4 ב: that he shall follow after them;
Exod 14:4 ג: and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh,
Exod 14:4 ד: and upon all his host;
Exod 14:4 ה: that the Egyptians may know that I [am] the LORD.
Exod 14:4 ו: And they did so.
Exod 14:5 א: And it was told the king of Egypt
Exod 14:5 ב: that the people fled:
Exod 14:5 ג: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people,
Exod 14:5 ד: and they said,
Exod 14:5 ה: Why have we done this,
Exod 14:5 ו: that we have let Israel go from serving us?
Exod 14:6 א: And he made ready his chariot,
Exod 14:6 ב: and took his people with him:
Exod 14:7 א: And he took six hundred chosen chariots,
Exod 14:7 ב: and all the chariots of Egypt,
Exod 14:7 ג: and captains over every one of them.
Exod 14:8 א: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh
Exod 14:8 ב: king of Egypt,
Exod 14:8 ג: and he pursued after the children of Israel:
Exod 14:8 ד: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.
Exod 14:9 א: But the Egyptians pursued after them,
Exod 14:9 ב: and overtook them encamping by the sea,
Exod 14:9 ג: all the horses [and] chariots of Pharaoh,
Exod 14:9 ד: and his horsemen, and his army,
Exod 14:9 ה: beside Pi–hahiroth,
Exod 14:9 ו: before Baal–zephon.
Exod 14:10 א: And when Pharaoh drew nigh,
Exod 14:10 ב: the children of Israel lifted up their eyes,
Exod 14:10 ג: and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them;
Exod 14:10 ד: and they were sore afraid:
Exod 14:10 ה: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.
Exod 14:11 א: And they said unto Moses,
Exod 14:11 ב: Because [there were] no graves in Egypt,
Exod 14:11 ג: hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness?
Exod 14:11 ד: wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us,
Exod 14:11 ה: to carry us forth out of Egypt?
Exod 14:12 א: [Is] not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying,
Exod 14:12 ב: Let us alone,
Exod 14:12 ג: that we may serve the Egyptians?
Exod 14:12 ד: For [it had been] better for us to serve the Egyptians,
Exod 14:12 ה: than that we should die in the wilderness.
Exod 14:13 א: And Moses said unto the people,
Exod 14:13 ב: Fear ye not,
Exod 14:13 ג: stand still,
Exod 14:13 ד: and see the salvation of the LORD,
Exod 14:13 ה: which he will shew to you to day:
Exod 14:13 ו: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day,
Exod 14:13 ז: ye shall see them again no more
Exod 14:13 ח: for ever.
Exod 14:14 א: The LORD shall fight for you,
Exod 14:14 ב: and ye shall hold your peace.
Exod 14:15 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 14:15 ב: Wherefore criest thou unto me?
Exod 14:15 ג: speak unto the children of Israel,
Exod 14:15 ד: that they go forward:
Exod 14:16 א: But lift thou up thy rod,
Exod 14:16 ב: and stretch out thine hand over the sea,
Exod 14:16 ג: and divide it:
Exod 14:16 ד: and the children of Israel shall go on dry [ground] through the midst of the sea.
Exod 14:17 א: And I,
Exod 14:17 ב: behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians,
Exod 14:17 ג: and they shall follow them:
Exod 14:17 ד: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh,
Exod 14:17 ה: and upon all his host,
Exod 14:17 ו: upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
Exod 14:18 א: And the Egyptians shall know that I [am] the LORD,
Exod 14:18 ב: when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh,
Exod 14:18 ג: upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
Exod 14:19 א: And the angel of God, [...] removed
Exod 14:19 ב: which went before the camp of Israel,
Exod 14:19 ג: and went behind them;
Exod 14:19 ד: and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face,
Exod 14:19 ה: and stood behind them:
Exod 14:20 א: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians
Exod 14:20 ב: and the camp of Israel;
Exod 14:20 ג: and it was a cloud and darkness [to them],
Exod 14:20 ד: but it gave light by night [to these]:
Exod 14:20 ה: so that the one came not near the other
Exod 14:20 ו: all the night.
Exod 14:21 א: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea;
Exod 14:21 ב: and the LORD caused the sea to go [back]
Exod 14:21 ג: by a strong east wind all that night,
Exod 14:21 ד: and made the sea dry [land],
Exod 14:21 ה: and the waters were divided.
Exod 14:22 א: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry [ground]:
Exod 14:22 ב: and the waters [were] a wall unto them
Exod 14:22 ג: on their right hand, and on their left.
Exod 14:23 א: And the Egyptians pursued,
Exod 14:23 ב: and went in after them [...] [even] all Pharaoh’s horses,
Exod 14:23 ג: his chariots, and his horsemen.
Exod 14:23 ד: to the midst of the sea,
Exod 14:24 א: And it came to pass, [...] in the morning watch
Exod 14:24 ב: that [...] the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians
Exod 14:24 ג: through the pillar of fire and of the cloud,
Exod 14:24 ד: and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
Exod 14:25 א: And took off their chariot wheels,
Exod 14:25 ב: that they drave them heavily:
Exod 14:25 ג: so that the Egyptians said,
Exod 14:25 ד: Let us flee from the face of Israel;
Exod 14:25 ה: for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
Exod 14:26 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 14:26 ב: Stretch out thine hand over the sea,
Exod 14:26 ג: that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians,
Exod 14:26 ד: upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
Exod 14:27 א: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea,
Exod 14:27 ב: and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared;
Exod 14:27 ג: and the Egyptians fled against it;
Exod 14:27 ד: and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
Exod 14:28 א: And the waters returned,
Exod 14:28 ב: and covered the chariots, and the horsemen,
Exod 14:28 ג: [and] all the host of Pharaoh
Exod 14:28 ד: that came into the sea after them;
Exod 14:28 ה: there remained not so much as one of them.
Exod 14:29 א: But the children of Israel walked upon dry [land]
Exod 14:29 ב: in the midst of the sea;
Exod 14:29 ג: and the waters [were] a wall unto them
Exod 14:29 ד: on their right hand, and on their left.
Exod 14:30 א: Thus the LORD saved [...] that day
Exod 14:30 ב: Israel [...] out of the hand of the Egyptians;
Exod 14:30 ג: and Israel saw the Egyptians
Exod 14:30 ד: dead upon the sea shore.
Exod 14:31 א: And Israel saw that great work
Exod 14:31 ב: which the LORD did upon the Egyptians:
Exod 14:31 ג: and the people feared the LORD,
Exod 14:31 ד: and believed the LORD,
Exod 14:31 ה: and his servant Moses.
Exod 15:1 א: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel
Exod 15:1 ב: this song unto the LORD,
Exod 15:1 ג: and spake, saying,
Exod 15:1 ד: I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously:
Exod 15:1 ה: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
Exod 15:2 א: The LORD [is] my strength and song,
Exod 15:2 ב: and he is become my salvation:
Exod 15:2 ג: he [is] my God,
Exod 15:2 ד: and I will prepare him an habitation;
Exod 15:2 ה: my father’s God,
Exod 15:2 ו: and I will exalt him.
Exod 15:3 א: The LORD [is] a man of war:
Exod 15:3 ב: the LORD [is] his name.
Exod 15:4 א: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host
Exod 15:4 ב: hath he cast into the sea:
Exod 15:4 ג: his chosen captains also
Exod 15:4 ד: are drowned in the Red sea.
Exod 15:5 א: The depths have covered them:
Exod 15:5 ב: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
Exod 15:6 א: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power:
Exod 15:6 ב: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
Exod 15:7 א: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee:
Exod 15:7 ב: thou sentest forth thy wrath,
Exod 15:7 ג: [which] consumed them as stubble.
Exod 15:8 א: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together,
Exod 15:8 ב: stood upright as an heap,
Exod 15:8 ג: the floods
Exod 15:8 ד: [and] the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
Exod 15:9 א: The enemy said,
Exod 15:9 ב: I will pursue, I will overtake,
Exod 15:9 ג: I will divide the spoil;
Exod 15:9 ד: my lust shall be satisfied upon them;
Exod 15:9 ה: I will draw my sword,
Exod 15:9 ו: my hand shall destroy them.
Exod 15:10 א: Thou didst blow with thy wind,
Exod 15:10 ב: the sea covered them:
Exod 15:10 ג: they sank as lead
Exod 15:10 ד: in the mighty waters.
Exod 15:11 א: Who [is] like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods?
Exod 15:11 ב: who [is] like thee, glorious in holiness,
Exod 15:11 ג: fearful [in] praises,
Exod 15:11 ד: doing wonders?
Exod 15:12 א: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand,
Exod 15:12 ב: the earth swallowed them.
Exod 15:13 א: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth
Exod 15:13 ב: the people [which] thou hast redeemed:
Exod 15:13 ג: thou hast guided [them] in thy strength
Exod 15:13 ד: unto thy holy habitation.
Exod 15:14 א: The people shall hear,
Exod 15:14 ב: [and] be afraid:
Exod 15:14 ג: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
Exod 15:15 א: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed;
Exod 15:15 ב: the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them;
Exod 15:15 ג: all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
Exod 15:16 א: Fear and dread shall fall upon them;
Exod 15:16 ב: by the greatness of thine arm they shall be [as] still as a stone;
Exod 15:16 ג: till thy people pass over, O LORD,
Exod 15:16 ד: till the people pass over, [which] thou hast purchased.
Exod 15:17 א: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance,
Exod 15:17 ב: [in] the place, O LORD, [which] thou hast made for thee to dwell in,
Exod 15:17 ג: [in] the Sanctuary, O Lord, [which] thy hands have established.
Exod 15:18 א: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.
Exod 15:19 א: For the horse of Pharaoh went in
Exod 15:19 ב: with his chariots and with his horsemen
Exod 15:19 ג: into the sea,
Exod 15:19 ד: and the LORD brought again [...] upon them;
Exod 15:19 ה: the waters of the sea
Exod 15:19 ו: but the children of Israel
Exod 15:19 ז: went on dry [land] in the midst of the sea.
Exod 15:20 א: And Miriam the prophetess, [...] took
Exod 15:20 ב: the sister of Aaron,
Exod 15:20 ג: a timbrel in her hand;
Exod 15:20 ד: and all the women went out after her
Exod 15:20 ה: with timbrels and with dances.
Exod 15:21 א: And Miriam answered them,
Exod 15:21 ב: Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously;
Exod 15:21 ג: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
Exod 15:22 א: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea,
Exod 15:22 ב: and they went out into the wilderness of Shur;
Exod 15:22 ג: and they went three days in the wilderness,
Exod 15:22 ד: and found no water.
Exod 15:23 א: And when they came to Marah,
Exod 15:23 ב: they could not drink of the waters of Marah,
Exod 15:23 ג: for they [were] bitter:
Exod 15:23 ד: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
Exod 15:24 א: And the people murmured against Moses, saying,
Exod 15:24 ב: What shall we drink?
Exod 15:25 א: And he cried unto the LORD;
Exod 15:25 ב: and the LORD shewed him a tree,
Exod 15:25 ג: [which] when he had cast into the waters,
Exod 15:25 ד: the waters were made sweet:
Exod 15:25 ה: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance,
Exod 15:25 ו: and there he proved them,
Exod 15:26 א: And said,
Exod 15:26 ב: If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God,
Exod 15:26 ג: and wilt do that which is right in his sight,
Exod 15:26 ד: and wilt give ear to his commandments,
Exod 15:26 ה: and keep all his statutes,
Exod 15:26 ו: of these diseases
Exod 15:26 ז: which I have brought upon the Egyptians:
Exod 15:26 ח: I will put none [...] upon thee,
Exod 15:26 ט: for I [am] the LORD that healeth thee.
Exod 15:27 א: And they came to Elim,
Exod 15:27 ב: where [were] twelve wells of water,
Exod 15:27 ג: and threescore and ten palm trees:
Exod 15:27 ד: and they encamped there by the waters.
Exod 16:1 א: And they took their journey from Elim,
Exod 16:1 ב: and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin,
Exod 16:1 ג: which [is] between Elim and Sinai,
Exod 16:1 ד: on the fifteenth day of the second month
Exod 16:1 ה: after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
Exod 16:2 א: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured
Exod 16:2 ב: against Moses and Aaron
Exod 16:2 ג: in the wilderness:
Exod 16:3 א: And the children of Israel said unto them,
Exod 16:3 ב: Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD
Exod 16:3 ג: in the land of Egypt,
Exod 16:3 ד: when we sat by the flesh pots,
Exod 16:3 ה: [and] when we did eat bread to the full;
Exod 16:3 ו: for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness,
Exod 16:3 ז: to kill this whole assembly
Exod 16:3 ח: with hunger.
Exod 16:4 א: Then said the LORD unto Moses,
Exod 16:4 ב: Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you;
Exod 16:4 ג: and the people shall go out
Exod 16:4 ד: and gather a certain rate every day,
Exod 16:4 ה: that I may prove them,
Exod 16:4 ו: whether they will walk in my law, or no.
Exod 16:5 א: And it shall come to pass, [...] on the sixth day
Exod 16:5 ב: that [...] they shall prepare [that] which they bring in;
Exod 16:5 ג: and it shall be twice as much as they gather
Exod 16:5 ד: daily.
Exod 16:6 א: And Moses and Aaron said
Exod 16:6 ב: unto all the children of Israel,
Exod 16:6 ג: At even,
Exod 16:6 ד: then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:
Exod 16:7 א: And in the morning,
Exod 16:7 ב: then ye shall see the glory of the LORD;
Exod 16:7 ג: for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD:
Exod 16:7 ד: and [...] we,
Exod 16:7 ה: what [are] [...] that ye murmur against us?
Exod 16:8 א: And Moses said,
Exod 16:8 ב: [This shall be], when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat,
Exod 16:8 ג: and in the morning bread to the full;
Exod 16:8 ד: for that the LORD heareth your murmurings
Exod 16:8 ה: which ye murmur against him:
Exod 16:8 ו: and [...] we?
Exod 16:8 ז: what [are] [...] your murmurings [are] not against us,
Exod 16:8 ח: but against the LORD.
Exod 16:9 א: And Moses spake unto Aaron,
Exod 16:9 ב: Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel,
Exod 16:9 ג: Come near before the LORD:
Exod 16:9 ד: for he hath heard your murmurings.
Exod 16:10 א: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel,
Exod 16:10 ב: that they looked toward the wilderness,
Exod 16:10 ג: and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.
Exod 16:11 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Exod 16:12 א: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel:
Exod 16:12 ב: speak unto them, saying,
Exod 16:12 ג: At even ye shall eat flesh,
Exod 16:12 ד: and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread;
Exod 16:12 ה: and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD your God.
Exod 16:13 א: And it came to pass, [...] at even
Exod 16:13 ב: that [...] the quails came up,
Exod 16:13 ג: and covered the camp:
Exod 16:13 ד: and in the morning
Exod 16:13 ה: the dew lay
Exod 16:13 ו: round about the host.
Exod 16:14 א: And when the dew that lay was gone up,
Exod 16:14 ב: behold,
Exod 16:14 ג: upon the face of the wilderness
Exod 16:14 ד: [there lay] a small round thing,
Exod 16:14 ה: [as] small as the hoar frost on the ground.
Exod 16:15 א: And when the children of Israel saw [it],
Exod 16:15 ב: they said one to another,
Exod 16:15 ג: It [is] manna:
Exod 16:15 ד: for they wist not what it [was].
Exod 16:15 ה: And Moses said unto them,
Exod 16:15 ו: This [is] the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.
Exod 16:16 א: This [is] the thing which the LORD hath commanded,
Exod 16:16 ב: Gather of it
Exod 16:16 ג: every man according to his eating,
Exod 16:16 ד: an omer for every man, [according to] the number of your persons;
Exod 16:16 ה: take ye every man for [them] which [are] in his tents.
Exod 16:17 א: And the children of Israel did so,
Exod 16:17 ב: and gathered, some more, some less.
Exod 16:18 א: And when they did mete [it] with an omer,
Exod 16:18 ב: he that gathered much had nothing over,
Exod 16:18 ג: and he that gathered little had no lack;
Exod 16:18 ד: they gathered every man according to his eating.
Exod 16:19 א: And Moses said,
Exod 16:19 ב: Let no man leave of it
Exod 16:19 ג: till the morning.
Exod 16:20 א: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses;
Exod 16:20 ב: but some of them left of it until the morning,
Exod 16:20 ג: and it bred worms, and stank:
Exod 16:20 ד: and Moses was wroth with them.
Exod 16:21 א: And they gathered it every morning,
Exod 16:21 ב: every man according to his eating:
Exod 16:21 ג: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
Exod 16:22 א: And it came to pass, [that] on the sixth day
Exod 16:22 ב: they gathered twice as much bread,
Exod 16:22 ג: two omers for one [man]:
Exod 16:22 ד: and all the rulers of the congregation came
Exod 16:22 ה: and told Moses.
Exod 16:23 א: And he said unto them,
Exod 16:23 ב: This [is that] which the LORD hath said,
Exod 16:23 ג: To morrow [is] the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD:
Exod 16:23 ד: bake [that] which ye will bake [to day],
Exod 16:23 ה: and seethe that ye will seethe;
Exod 16:23 ו: and that which remaineth over
Exod 16:23 ז: lay up for you
Exod 16:23 ח: to be kept until the morning.
Exod 16:24 א: And they laid it up till the morning,
Exod 16:24 ב: as Moses bade:
Exod 16:24 ג: and it did not stink,
Exod 16:24 ד: neither was there any worm therein.
Exod 16:25 א: And Moses said, Eat that to day;
Exod 16:25 ב: for to day [is] a sabbath unto the LORD:
Exod 16:25 ג: to day ye shall not find it in the field.
Exod 16:26 א: Six days ye shall gather it;
Exod 16:26 ב: but on the seventh day,
Exod 16:26 ג: [which is] the sabbath,
Exod 16:26 ד: in it there shall be none.
Exod 16:27 א: And it came to pass, [...] on the seventh day
Exod 16:27 ב: [that] there went out [some] of the people [...] for to gather,
Exod 16:27 ג: and they found none.
Exod 16:28 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 16:28 ב: How long
Exod 16:28 ג: refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
Exod 16:29 א: See, for that the LORD
Exod 16:29 ב: hath given you the sabbath,
Exod 16:29 ג: therefore he giveth you
Exod 16:29 ד: on the sixth day
Exod 16:29 ה: the bread of two days;
Exod 16:29 ו: abide ye every man in his place,
Exod 16:29 ז: let no man go out of his place
Exod 16:29 ח: on the seventh day.
Exod 16:30 א: So the people rested on the seventh day.
Exod 16:31 א: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna:
Exod 16:31 ב: and it [was] like coriander seed, white;
Exod 16:31 ג: and the taste of it [was] like wafers [made] with honey.
Exod 16:32 א: And Moses said,
Exod 16:32 ב: This [is] the thing which the LORD commandeth,
Exod 16:32 ג: Fill an omer of it
Exod 16:32 ד: to be kept for your generations;
Exod 16:32 ה: that they may see the bread
Exod 16:32 ו: wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness,
Exod 16:32 ז: when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
Exod 16:33 א: And Moses said unto Aaron,
Exod 16:33 ב: Take a pot,
Exod 16:33 ג: and put an omer full of manna therein,
Exod 16:33 ד: and lay it up before the LORD,
Exod 16:33 ה: to be kept for your generations.
Exod 16:34 א: As the LORD commanded Moses,
Exod 16:34 ב: so Aaron laid it up
Exod 16:34 ג: before the Testimony, to be kept.
Exod 16:35 א: And the children of Israel
Exod 16:35 ב: did eat manna forty years,
Exod 16:35 ג: until they came to a land inhabited;
Exod 16:35 ד: they did eat manna,
Exod 16:35 ה: until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
Exod 16:36 א: Now an omer [is] the tenth [part] of an ephah.
Exod 17:1 א: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed
Exod 17:1 ב: from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys,
Exod 17:1 ג: according to the commandment of the LORD,
Exod 17:1 ד: and pitched in Rephidim:
Exod 17:1 ה: and [there was] no water for the people to drink.
Exod 17:2 א: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said,
Exod 17:2 ב: Give us water that we may drink.
Exod 17:2 ג: And Moses said unto them,
Exod 17:2 ד: Why chide ye with me?
Exod 17:2 ה: wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?
Exod 17:3 א: And the people thirsted there for water;
Exod 17:3 ב: and the people murmured against Moses, and said,
Exod 17:3 ג: Wherefore [is] this [that] thou hast brought us up out of Egypt,
Exod 17:3 ד: to kill us
Exod 17:3 ה: and our children and our cattle
Exod 17:3 ו: with thirst?
Exod 17:4 א: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying,
Exod 17:4 ב: What shall I do unto this people?
Exod 17:4 ג: they be almost ready to stone me.
Exod 17:5 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 17:5 ב: Go on before the people,
Exod 17:5 ג: and take with thee of the elders of Israel;
Exod 17:5 ד: and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river,
Exod 17:5 ה: take in thine hand, and go.
Exod 17:6 א: Behold, I will stand before thee
Exod 17:6 ב: there upon the rock in Horeb;
Exod 17:6 ג: and thou shalt smite the rock,
Exod 17:6 ד: and there shall come water out of it,
Exod 17:6 ה: that the people may drink.
Exod 17:6 ו: And Moses did so
Exod 17:6 ז: in the sight of the elders of Israel.
Exod 17:7 א: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah,
Exod 17:7 ב: because of the chiding of the children of Israel,
Exod 17:7 ג: and because they tempted the LORD, saying,
Exod 17:7 ד: Is the LORD among us,
Exod 17:7 ה: or not?
Exod 17:8 א: Then came Amalek,
Exod 17:8 ב: and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
Exod 17:9 א: And Moses said unto Joshua,
Exod 17:9 ב: Choose us out men, and go out,
Exod 17:9 ג: fight with Amalek: to morrow
Exod 17:9 ד: I will stand on the top of the hill
Exod 17:9 ה: with the rod of God in mine hand.
Exod 17:10 א: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him,
Exod 17:10 ב: and fought with Amalek:
Exod 17:10 ג: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur
Exod 17:10 ד: went up to the top of the hill.
Exod 17:11 א: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand,
Exod 17:11 ב: that Israel prevailed:
Exod 17:11 ג: and when he let down his hand,
Exod 17:11 ד: Amalek prevailed.
Exod 17:12 א: But Moses’ hands [were] heavy;
Exod 17:12 ב: and they took a stone, and put [it] under him,
Exod 17:12 ג: and he sat thereon;
Exod 17:12 ד: and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands,
Exod 17:12 ה: the one on the one side,
Exod 17:12 ו: and the other on the other side;
Exod 17:12 ז: and his hands were steady
Exod 17:12 ח: until the going down of the sun.
Exod 17:13 א: And Joshua discomfited Amalek
Exod 17:13 ב: and his people with the edge of the sword.
Exod 17:14 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 17:14 ב: Write this [for] a memorial in a book,
Exod 17:14 ג: and rehearse [it] in the ears of Joshua:
Exod 17:14 ד: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek
Exod 17:14 ה: from under heaven.
Exod 17:15 א: And Moses built an altar,
Exod 17:15 ב: and called the name of it Jehovah–nissi:
Exod 17:16 א: For he said,
Exod 17:16 ב: Because the LORD hath sworn
Exod 17:16 ג: [that] the LORD [will have] war with Amalek
Exod 17:16 ד: from generation to generation.
Exod 18:1 א: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, [...] heard
Exod 18:1 ב: Moses’ father in law,
Exod 18:1 ג: of all that God had done
Exod 18:1 ד: for Moses, and for Israel his people,
Exod 18:1 ה: [and] that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;
Exod 18:2 א: Then Jethro, [...] took
Exod 18:2 ב: Moses’ father in law,
Exod 18:2 ג: Zipporah, Moses’ wife,
Exod 18:2 ד: after he had sent her back,
Exod 18:3 א: And her two sons;
Exod 18:3 ב: of which the name of the one [was] Gershom;
Exod 18:3 ג: for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
Exod 18:4 א: And the name of the other [was] Eliezer;
Exod 18:4 ב: for the God of my father, [said he, was] mine help,
Exod 18:4 ג: and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
Exod 18:5 א: And Jethro, [...] came
Exod 18:5 ב: Moses’ father in law,
Exod 18:5 ג: with his sons and his wife unto Moses
Exod 18:5 ד: into the wilderness, where he encamped at
Exod 18:5 ה: the mount of God:
Exod 18:6 א: And he said unto Moses,
Exod 18:6 ב: I thy father in law Jethro
Exod 18:6 ג: am come unto thee,
Exod 18:6 ד: and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
Exod 18:7 א: And Moses went out to meet his father in law,
Exod 18:7 ב: and did obeisance,
Exod 18:7 ג: and kissed him;
Exod 18:7 ד: and they asked each other of [their] welfare;
Exod 18:7 ה: and they came into the tent.
Exod 18:8 א: And Moses told his father in law
Exod 18:8 ב: all that the LORD had done
Exod 18:8 ג: unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians
Exod 18:8 ד: for Israel’s sake,
Exod 18:8 ה: [and] all the travail that had come upon them by the way,
Exod 18:8 ו: and [how] the LORD delivered them.
Exod 18:9 א: And Jethro rejoiced
Exod 18:9 ב: for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel,
Exod 18:9 ג: whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
Exod 18:10 א: And Jethro said,
Exod 18:10 ב: Blessed [be] the LORD,
Exod 18:10 ג: who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians,
Exod 18:10 ד: and out of the hand of Pharaoh,
Exod 18:10 ה: who hath delivered the people
Exod 18:10 ו: from under the hand of the Egyptians.
Exod 18:11 א: Now I know that
Exod 18:11 ב: the LORD [is] greater than all gods:
Exod 18:11 ג: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly
Exod 18:11 ד: [he was] above them.
Exod 18:12 א: And Jethro, [...] took
Exod 18:12 ב: Moses’ father in law,
Exod 18:12 ג: a burnt offering and sacrifices for God:
Exod 18:12 ד: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel,
Exod 18:12 ה: to eat bread with Moses’ father in law
Exod 18:12 ו: before God.
Exod 18:13 א: And it came to pass on the morrow,
Exod 18:13 ב: that Moses sat to judge the people:
Exod 18:13 ג: and the people stood by Moses
Exod 18:13 ד: from the morning unto the evening.
Exod 18:14 א: And when Moses’ father in law saw
Exod 18:14 ב: all that he did to the people,
Exod 18:14 ג: he said,
Exod 18:14 ד: What [is] this thing
Exod 18:14 ה: that thou doest to the people?
Exod 18:14 ו: why sittest thou thyself alone,
Exod 18:14 ז: and all the people stand by thee
Exod 18:14 ח: from morning unto even?
Exod 18:15 א: And Moses said unto his father in law,
Exod 18:15 ב: Because the people come unto me
Exod 18:15 ג: to inquire of God:
Exod 18:16 א: When they have a matter,
Exod 18:16 ב: they come unto me;
Exod 18:16 ג: and I judge between one and another,
Exod 18:16 ד: and I do make [them] know the statutes of God,
Exod 18:16 ה: and his laws.
Exod 18:17 א: And Moses’ father in law said unto him,
Exod 18:17 ב: The thing that thou doest [is] not good.
Exod 18:18 א: Thou wilt surely wear away,
Exod 18:18 ב: both thou,
Exod 18:18 ג: and this people that [is] with thee:
Exod 18:18 ד: for this thing [is] too heavy for thee;
Exod 18:18 ה: thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
Exod 18:19 א: Hearken now unto my voice,
Exod 18:19 ב: I will give thee counsel,
Exod 18:19 ג: and God shall be with thee:
Exod 18:19 ד: Be thou for the people to God-ward,
Exod 18:19 ה: that thou mayest bring the causes
Exod 18:19 ו: unto God:
Exod 18:20 א: And thou shalt teach them
Exod 18:20 ב: ordinances and laws,
Exod 18:20 ג: and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk,
Exod 18:20 ד: and the work that they must do.
Exod 18:21 א: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people
Exod 18:21 ב: able men,
Exod 18:21 ג: such as fear God,
Exod 18:21 ד: men of truth,
Exod 18:21 ה: hating covetousness;
Exod 18:21 ו: and place [such] over them, [to be] rulers of thousands,
Exod 18:21 ז: [and] rulers of hundreds,
Exod 18:21 ח: rulers of fifties,
Exod 18:21 ט: and rulers of tens:
Exod 18:22 א: And let them judge the people
Exod 18:22 ב: at all seasons:
Exod 18:22 ג: and it shall be, [that] every great matter
Exod 18:22 ד: they shall bring unto thee,
Exod 18:22 ה: but every small matter
Exod 18:22 ו: they shall judge:
Exod 18:22 ז: so shall it be easier for thyself,
Exod 18:22 ח: and they shall bear [the burden] with thee.
Exod 18:23 א: If thou shalt do this thing,
Exod 18:23 ב: and God command thee [so],
Exod 18:23 ג: then thou shalt be able to endure,
Exod 18:23 ד: and all this people [...] also
Exod 18:23 ה: shall [...] go to their place in peace.
Exod 18:24 א: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law,
Exod 18:24 ב: and did all that he had said.
Exod 18:25 א: And Moses chose able men
Exod 18:25 ב: out of all Israel,
Exod 18:25 ג: and made them heads over the people,
Exod 18:25 ד: rulers of thousands,
Exod 18:25 ה: rulers of hundreds,
Exod 18:25 ו: rulers of fifties,
Exod 18:25 ז: and rulers of tens.
Exod 18:26 א: And they judged the people at all seasons:
Exod 18:26 ב: the hard causes
Exod 18:26 ג: they brought unto Moses,
Exod 18:26 ד: but every small matter
Exod 18:26 ה: they judged themselves.
Exod 18:27 א: And Moses let his father in law depart;
Exod 18:27 ב: and he went his way into his own land.
Exod 19:1 א: In the third month,
Exod 19:1 ב: when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt,
Exod 19:1 ג: the same day
Exod 19:1 ד: came they [into] the wilderness of Sinai.
Exod 19:2 א: For they were departed from Rephidim,
Exod 19:2 ב: and were come [to] the desert of Sinai,
Exod 19:2 ג: and had pitched in the wilderness;
Exod 19:2 ד: and there Israel camped
Exod 19:2 ה: before the mount.
Exod 19:3 א: And Moses went up unto God,
Exod 19:3 ב: and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying,
Exod 19:3 ג: Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob,
Exod 19:3 ד: and tell the children of Israel;
Exod 19:4 א: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians,
Exod 19:4 ב: and [how] I bare you on eagles’ wings,
Exod 19:4 ג: and brought you unto myself.
Exod 19:5 א: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed,
Exod 19:5 ב: and keep my covenant,
Exod 19:5 ג: then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people:
Exod 19:5 ד: for all the earth [is] mine:
Exod 19:6 א: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests,
Exod 19:6 ב: and an holy nation.
Exod 19:6 ג: These [are] the words which thou shalt speak
Exod 19:6 ד: unto the children of Israel.
Exod 19:7 א: And Moses came
Exod 19:7 ב: and called for the elders of the people,
Exod 19:7 ג: and laid before their faces
Exod 19:7 ד: all these words
Exod 19:7 ה: which the LORD commanded him.
Exod 19:8 א: And all the people answered together, and said,
Exod 19:8 ב: All that the LORD hath spoken we will do.
Exod 19:8 ג: And Moses returned
Exod 19:8 ד: the words of the people
Exod 19:8 ה: unto the LORD.
Exod 19:9 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 19:9 ב: Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud,
Exod 19:9 ג: that the people may hear when I speak with thee,
Exod 19:9 ד: and believe thee for ever.
Exod 19:9 ה: And Moses told the words of the people
Exod 19:9 ו: unto the LORD.
Exod 19:10 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 19:10 ב: Go unto the people,
Exod 19:10 ג: and sanctify them to day and to morrow,
Exod 19:10 ד: and let them wash their clothes,
Exod 19:11 א: And be ready against the third day:
Exod 19:11 ב: for the third day
Exod 19:11 ג: the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people
Exod 19:11 ד: upon mount Sinai.
Exod 19:12 א: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying,
Exod 19:12 ב: Take heed to yourselves,
Exod 19:12 ג: [that ye] go [not] up into the mount, or touch the border of it:
Exod 19:12 ד: whosoever toucheth the mount
Exod 19:12 ה: shall be surely put to death:
Exod 19:13 א: There shall not an hand touch it,
Exod 19:13 ב: but he shall surely be stoned,
Exod 19:13 ג: or shot through;
Exod 19:13 ד: whether [it be] beast or man,
Exod 19:13 ה: it shall not live:
Exod 19:13 ו: when the trumpet soundeth long,
Exod 19:13 ז: they shall come up to the mount.
Exod 19:14 א: And Moses went down from the mount
Exod 19:14 ב: unto the people,
Exod 19:14 ג: and sanctified the people;
Exod 19:14 ד: and they washed their clothes.
Exod 19:15 א: And he said unto the people,
Exod 19:15 ב: Be ready against the third day:
Exod 19:15 ג: come not at [your] wives.
Exod 19:16 א: And it came to pass on the third day
Exod 19:16 ב: in the morning,
Exod 19:16 ג: that there were thunders and lightnings,
Exod 19:16 ד: and a thick cloud upon the mount,
Exod 19:16 ה: and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud;
Exod 19:16 ו: so that all the people that [was] in the camp trembled.
Exod 19:17 א: And Moses brought forth the people
Exod 19:17 ב: out of the camp to meet with God;
Exod 19:17 ג: and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
Exod 19:18 א: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke,
Exod 19:18 ב: because the LORD descended upon it in fire:
Exod 19:18 ג: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace,
Exod 19:18 ד: and the whole mount quaked greatly.
Exod 19:19 א: And when the voice of the trumpet
Exod 19:19 ב: sounded long, and waxed louder and louder,
Exod 19:19 ג: Moses spake,
Exod 19:19 ד: and God answered him by a voice.
Exod 19:20 א: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai,
Exod 19:20 ב: on the top of the mount:
Exod 19:20 ג: and the LORD called Moses
Exod 19:20 ד: [up] to the top of the mount;
Exod 19:20 ה: and Moses went up.
Exod 19:21 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 19:21 ב: Go down, charge the people,
Exod 19:21 ג: lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze,
Exod 19:21 ד: and many of them perish.
Exod 19:22 א: And let the priests also,
Exod 19:22 ב: which come near to the LORD,
Exod 19:22 ג: sanctify themselves,
Exod 19:22 ד: lest the LORD break forth upon them.
Exod 19:23 א: And Moses said unto the LORD,
Exod 19:23 ב: The people cannot come up to mount Sinai:
Exod 19:23 ג: for thou chargedst us, saying,
Exod 19:23 ד: Set bounds about the mount,
Exod 19:23 ה: and sanctify it.
Exod 19:24 א: And the LORD said unto him,
Exod 19:24 ב: Away,
Exod 19:24 ג: get thee down,
Exod 19:24 ד: and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee:
Exod 19:24 ה: but [...] the priests and the people
Exod 19:24 ו: let not [...] break through to come up unto the LORD,
Exod 19:24 ז: lest he break forth upon them.
Exod 19:25 א: So Moses went down unto the people,
Exod 19:25 ב: and spake unto them.
Exod 20:1 א: And God spake
Exod 20:1 ב: all these words, saying,
Exod 20:2 א: I [am] the LORD thy God,
Exod 20:2 ב: which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt,
Exod 20:2 ג: out of the house of bondage.
Exod 20:3 א: Thou shalt have no other gods
Exod 20:3 ב: before me.
Exod 20:4 א: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image,
Exod 20:4 ב: or any likeness [of any thing] that [is] in heaven above,
Exod 20:4 ג: or that [is] in the earth beneath,
Exod 20:4 ד: or that [is] in the water under the earth:
Exod 20:5 א: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them,
Exod 20:5 ב: nor serve them:
Exod 20:5 ג: for I the LORD thy God [am]
Exod 20:5 ד: a jealous God,
Exod 20:5 ה: visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children
Exod 20:5 ו: unto the third
Exod 20:5 ז: and fourth [generation]
Exod 20:5 ח: of them that hate me;
Exod 20:6 א: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me,
Exod 20:6 ב: and keep my commandments.
Exod 20:7 א: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain;
Exod 20:7 ב: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless
Exod 20:7 ג: that taketh his name
Exod 20:7 ד: in vain.
Exod 20:8 א: Remember the sabbath day,
Exod 20:8 ב: to keep it holy.
Exod 20:9 א: Six days shalt thou labour,
Exod 20:9 ב: and do all thy work:
Exod 20:10 א: But the seventh day [is] the sabbath of the LORD thy God:
Exod 20:10 ב: [in it] thou shalt not do any work, thou,
Exod 20:10 ג: nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger
Exod 20:10 ד: that [is] within thy gates:
Exod 20:11 א: For [in] six days the LORD made
Exod 20:11 ב: heaven and earth,
Exod 20:11 ג: the sea, and all that in them [is],
Exod 20:11 ד: and rested the seventh day:
Exod 20:11 ה: wherefore the LORD blessed
Exod 20:11 ו: the sabbath day,
Exod 20:11 ז: and hallowed it.
Exod 20:12 א: Honour thy father and thy mother:
Exod 20:12 ב: that thy days may be long upon the land
Exod 20:12 ג: which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
Exod 20:13 א: Thou shalt not kill.
Exod 20:14 א: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
Exod 20:15 א: Thou shalt not steal.
Exod 20:16 א: Thou shalt not bear [...] against thy neighbour.
Exod 20:16 ב: false witness
Exod 20:17 א: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house,
Exod 20:17 ב: thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife,
Exod 20:17 ג: nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass,
Exod 20:17 ד: nor any thing that [is] thy neighbour’s.
Exod 20:18 א: And all the people saw the thunderings,
Exod 20:18 ב: and the lightnings,
Exod 20:18 ג: and the noise of the trumpet,
Exod 20:18 ד: and the mountain smoking:
Exod 20:18 ה: and when the people saw [it],
Exod 20:18 ו: they removed, and stood afar off.
Exod 20:19 א: And they said unto Moses,
Exod 20:19 ב: Speak thou with us,
Exod 20:19 ג: and we will hear:
Exod 20:19 ד: but let not God speak with us,
Exod 20:19 ה: lest we die.
Exod 20:20 א: And Moses said unto the people,
Exod 20:20 ב: Fear not:
Exod 20:20 ג: for [...] to prove you,
Exod 20:20 ד: God is come
Exod 20:20 ה: and that his fear may be before your faces,
Exod 20:20 ו: that ye sin not.
Exod 20:21 א: And the people stood afar off,
Exod 20:21 ב: and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness
Exod 20:21 ג: where God [was].
Exod 20:22 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 20:22 ב: Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel,
Exod 20:22 ג: Ye have seen that [...] from heaven.
Exod 20:22 ד: I have talked with you
Exod 20:23 א: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver,
Exod 20:23 ב: gods of gold.
Exod 20:23 ג: neither shall ye make unto you
Exod 20:24 א: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me,
Exod 20:24 ב: and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings,
Exod 20:24 ג: and thy peace offerings,
Exod 20:24 ד: thy sheep,
Exod 20:24 ה: and thine oxen:
Exod 20:24 ו: in all places where I record my name
Exod 20:24 ז: I will come unto thee,
Exod 20:24 ח: and I will bless thee.
Exod 20:25 א: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone,
Exod 20:25 ב: thou shalt not build it of hewn stone:
Exod 20:25 ג: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it,
Exod 20:25 ד: thou hast polluted it.
Exod 20:26 א: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar,
Exod 20:26 ב: that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
Exod 21:1 א: Now these [are] the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
Exod 21:2 א: If thou buy an Hebrew servant,
Exod 21:2 ב: six years he shall serve:
Exod 21:2 ג: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
Exod 21:3 א: If he came in by himself,
Exod 21:3 ב: he shall go out by himself:
Exod 21:3 ג: if he were married,
Exod 21:3 ד: then his wife shall go out with him.
Exod 21:4 א: If his master have given him a wife,
Exod 21:4 ב: and she have born him sons or daughters;
Exod 21:4 ג: the wife and her children shall be her master’s,
Exod 21:4 ד: and he shall go out by himself.
Exod 21:5 א: And if the servant shall plainly say,
Exod 21:5 ב: I love my master,
Exod 21:5 ג: my wife,
Exod 21:5 ד: and my children;
Exod 21:5 ה: I will not go out free:
Exod 21:6 א: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges;
Exod 21:6 ב: he shall also bring him to the door,
Exod 21:6 ג: or unto the door post;
Exod 21:6 ד: and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul;
Exod 21:6 ה: and he shall serve him for ever.
Exod 21:7 א: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant,
Exod 21:7 ב: she shall not go out as the menservants do.
Exod 21:8 א: If she please not her master,
Exod 21:8 ב: who hath betrothed her to himself,
Exod 21:8 ג: then shall he let her be redeemed: [...] her unto a strange nation
Exod 21:8 ד: to sell [...] he shall have no power,
Exod 21:8 ה: seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
Exod 21:9 א: And if he have betrothed her unto his son,
Exod 21:9 ב: he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
Exod 21:10 א: If he take him another [wife];
Exod 21:10 ב: her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage,
Exod 21:10 ג: shall he not diminish.
Exod 21:11 א: And if [...] these three
Exod 21:11 ב: he do not [...] unto her,
Exod 21:11 ג: then shall she go out free
Exod 21:11 ד: without money.
Exod 21:12 א: He that smiteth a man, so that he die,
Exod 21:12 ב: shall be surely put to death.
Exod 21:13 א: And if a man lie not in wait,
Exod 21:13 ב: but God deliver [him] into his hand;
Exod 21:13 ג: then I will appoint thee a place
Exod 21:13 ד: whither he shall flee.
Exod 21:14 א: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour,
Exod 21:14 ב: to slay him with guile;
Exod 21:14 ג: thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
Exod 21:15 א: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother,
Exod 21:15 ב: shall be surely put to death.
Exod 21:16 א: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him,
Exod 21:16 ב: or if he be found in his hand,
Exod 21:16 ג: he shall surely be put to death.
Exod 21:17 א: And he that curseth his father, or his mother,
Exod 21:17 ב: shall surely be put to death.
Exod 21:18 א: And if men strive together,
Exod 21:18 ב: and one smite another
Exod 21:18 ג: with a stone, or with [his] fist,
Exod 21:18 ד: and he die not,
Exod 21:18 ה: but keepeth [his] bed:
Exod 21:19 א: If he rise again,
Exod 21:19 ב: and walk abroad upon his staff,
Exod 21:19 ג: then shall he that smote [him] be quit:
Exod 21:19 ד: only he shall pay [for] the loss of his time,
Exod 21:19 ה: and shall cause [him] to be thoroughly healed.
Exod 21:20 א: And if a man smite his servant,
Exod 21:20 ב: or his maid,
Exod 21:20 ג: with a rod,
Exod 21:20 ד: and he die under his hand;
Exod 21:20 ה: he shall be surely punished.
Exod 21:21 א: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two,
Exod 21:21 ב: he shall not be punished:
Exod 21:21 ג: for he [is] his money.
Exod 21:22 א: If men strive,
Exod 21:22 ב: and hurt a woman with child,
Exod 21:22 ג: so that her fruit depart [from her],
Exod 21:22 ד: and yet no mischief follow:
Exod 21:22 ה: he shall be surely punished,
Exod 21:22 ו: according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him;
Exod 21:22 ז: and he shall pay as the judges [determine].
Exod 21:23 א: And if [any] mischief follow,
Exod 21:23 ב: then thou shalt give life for life,
Exod 21:24 א: Eye for eye,
Exod 21:24 ב: tooth for tooth,
Exod 21:24 ג: hand for hand,
Exod 21:24 ד: foot for foot,
Exod 21:25 א: Burning for burning,
Exod 21:25 ב: wound for wound,
Exod 21:25 ג: stripe for stripe.
Exod 21:26 א: And if a man smite the eye of his servant,
Exod 21:26 ב: or the eye of his maid,
Exod 21:26 ג: that it perish;
Exod 21:26 ד: he shall let him go free
Exod 21:26 ה: for his eye’s sake.
Exod 21:27 א: And if [...] his manservant’s tooth,
Exod 21:27 ב: or his maidservant’s tooth;
Exod 21:27 ג: he smite out
Exod 21:27 ד: he shall let him go free
Exod 21:27 ה: for his tooth’s sake.
Exod 21:28 א: If an ox gore a man
Exod 21:28 ב: or a woman,
Exod 21:28 ג: that they die:
Exod 21:28 ד: then the ox shall be surely stoned,
Exod 21:28 ה: and his flesh shall not be eaten;
Exod 21:28 ו: but the owner of the ox [shall be] quit.
Exod 21:29 א: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn
Exod 21:29 ב: in time past,
Exod 21:29 ג: and it hath been testified to his owner,
Exod 21:29 ד: and he hath not kept him in,
Exod 21:29 ה: but that he hath killed a man or a woman;
Exod 21:29 ו: the ox shall be stoned,
Exod 21:29 ז: and his owner also shall be put to death.
Exod 21:30 א: If there be laid on him a sum of money,
Exod 21:30 ב: then he shall give for the ransom of his life
Exod 21:30 ג: whatsoever is laid upon him.
Exod 21:31 א: Whether he have gored a son,
Exod 21:31 ב: or have gored a daughter,
Exod 21:31 ג: according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
Exod 21:32 א: If the ox shall push a manservant
Exod 21:32 ב: or a maidservant;
Exod 21:32 ג: he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver,
Exod 21:32 ד: and the ox shall be stoned.
Exod 21:33 א: And if a man shall open a pit,
Exod 21:33 ב: or if a man shall dig a pit,
Exod 21:33 ג: and not cover it,
Exod 21:33 ד: fall therein;
Exod 21:33 ה: and an ox or an ass
Exod 21:34 א: The owner of the pit shall make [it] good,
Exod 21:34 ב: [and] give money unto the owner of them;
Exod 21:34 ג: and the dead [beast] shall be his.
Exod 21:35 א: And if one man’s ox hurt
Exod 21:35 ב: another’s,
Exod 21:35 ג: that he die;
Exod 21:35 ד: then they shall sell the live ox,
Exod 21:35 ה: and divide the money of it;
Exod 21:35 ו: and the dead [ox] also they shall divide.
Exod 21:36 א: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push
Exod 21:36 ב: in time past,
Exod 21:36 ג: and his owner hath not kept him in;
Exod 21:36 ד: he shall surely pay ox for ox;
Exod 21:36 ה: and the dead shall be his own.
Exod 22:1 א: If a man shall steal an ox,
Exod 22:1 ב: or a sheep,
Exod 22:1 ג: and kill it,
Exod 22:1 ד: or sell it;
Exod 22:1 ה: he shall restore five oxen for an ox,
Exod 22:1 ו: and four sheep for a sheep.
Exod 22:2 א: If a thief be found breaking up,
Exod 22:2 ב: and be smitten that he die,
Exod 22:2 ג: [there shall] no blood [be shed] for him.
Exod 22:3 א: If the sun be risen upon him,
Exod 22:3 ב: [there shall be] blood [shed] for him;
Exod 22:3 ג: [for] he should make full restitution;
Exod 22:3 ד: if he have nothing,
Exod 22:3 ה: then he shall be sold for his theft.
Exod 22:4 א: If the theft be certainly found in his hand
Exod 22:4 ב: whether it be ox, or ass,
Exod 22:4 ג: alive, [...] or sheep;
Exod 22:4 ד: he shall restore double.
Exod 22:5 א: If a man shall cause a field [...] to be eaten,
Exod 22:5 ב: or vineyard
Exod 22:5 ג: and shall put in his beast,
Exod 22:5 ד: and shall feed in another man’s field;
Exod 22:5 ה: of the best of his own field,
Exod 22:5 ו: and of the best of his own vineyard,
Exod 22:5 ז: shall he make restitution.
Exod 22:6 א: If fire break out,
Exod 22:6 ב: and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, [...] be consumed [therewith];
Exod 22:6 ג: or the standing corn,
Exod 22:6 ד: or the field,
Exod 22:6 ה: shall surely make restitution.
Exod 22:6 ו: he that kindled the fire
Exod 22:7 א: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money
Exod 22:7 ב: or stuff to keep,
Exod 22:7 ג: and it be stolen out of the man’s house;
Exod 22:7 ד: if the thief be found,
Exod 22:7 ה: let him pay double.
Exod 22:8 א: If the thief be not found, then
Exod 22:8 ב: the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges,
Exod 22:8 ג: [to see] whether he have put his hand
Exod 22:8 ד: unto his neighbour’s goods.
Exod 22:9 א: For all manner of trespass,
Exod 22:9 ב: [whether it be] for ox,
Exod 22:9 ג: for ass,
Exod 22:9 ד: for sheep,
Exod 22:9 ה: for raiment,
Exod 22:9 ו: [or] for any manner of lost thing, which [another] challengeth
Exod 22:9 ז: to be his,
Exod 22:9 ח: the cause of both parties shall come before the judges;
Exod 22:9 ט: [and] whom the judges shall condemn,
Exod 22:9 י: he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
Exod 22:10 א: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass,
Exod 22:10 ב: or an ox,
Exod 22:10 ג: or a sheep,
Exod 22:10 ד: or any beast, to keep;
Exod 22:10 ה: and it die,
Exod 22:10 ו: or be hurt,
Exod 22:10 ז: or driven away,
Exod 22:10 ח: no man seeing [it]:
Exod 22:11 א: [Then] shall an oath of the LORD be between them both,
Exod 22:11 ב: that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods;
Exod 22:11 ג: and the owner of it shall accept [thereof], and he shall not make [it] good.
Exod 22:12 א: And if it be stolen from him,
Exod 22:12 ב: he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
Exod 22:13 א: If it be torn in pieces,
Exod 22:13 ב: [then] let him bring it [for] witness, [and] [...] that which was torn.
Exod 22:13 ג: he shall not make good
Exod 22:14 א: And if a man borrow [ought] of his neighbour,
Exod 22:14 ב: and it be hurt,
Exod 22:14 ג: or die,
Exod 22:14 ד: the owner thereof [being] not with it,
Exod 22:14 ה: he shall surely make [it] good.
Exod 22:15 א: [But] if the owner thereof [be] with it,
Exod 22:15 ב: he shall not make [it] good:
Exod 22:15 ג: if it [be] an hired [thing],
Exod 22:15 ד: it came for his hire.
Exod 22:16 א: And if a man entice a maid
Exod 22:16 ב: that is not betrothed,
Exod 22:16 ג: and lie with her,
Exod 22:16 ד: he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
Exod 22:17 א: If her father utterly refuse
Exod 22:17 ב: to give her unto him,
Exod 22:17 ג: he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
Exod 22:18 א: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
Exod 22:19 א: Whosoever lieth with a beast
Exod 22:19 ב: shall surely be put to death.
Exod 22:20 א: He that sacrificeth unto [any] god, [...] he shall be utterly destroyed.
Exod 22:20 ב: save unto the LORD only,
Exod 22:21 א: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger,
Exod 22:21 ב: nor oppress him:
Exod 22:21 ג: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
Exod 22:22 א: any widow, or fatherless child.
Exod 22:22 ב: Ye shall not afflict
Exod 22:23 א: If thou afflict them in any wise,
Exod 22:23 ב: and they cry at all unto me,
Exod 22:23 ג: I will surely hear their cry;
Exod 22:24 א: And my wrath shall wax hot,
Exod 22:24 ב: and I will kill you with the sword;
Exod 22:24 ג: and your wives shall be widows,
Exod 22:24 ד: and your children fatherless.
Exod 22:25 א: If thou lend money to [any of] my people
Exod 22:25 ב: [that is] poor by thee,
Exod 22:25 ג: thou shalt not be to him as an usurer,
Exod 22:25 ד: neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
Exod 22:26 א: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s raiment to pledge,
Exod 22:26 ב: by that the sun goeth down:
Exod 22:26 ג: thou shalt deliver it unto him
Exod 22:27 א: For that [is] his covering only,
Exod 22:27 ב: it [is] his raiment for his skin:
Exod 22:27 ג: wherein shall he sleep?
Exod 22:27 ד: and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me,
Exod 22:27 ה: that I will hear;
Exod 22:27 ו: for I [am] gracious.
Exod 22:28 א: Thou shalt not revile the gods,
Exod 22:28 ב: nor curse the ruler of thy people.
Exod 22:29 א: Thou shalt not delay [to offer] the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors:
Exod 22:29 ב: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
Exod 22:30 א: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, [and] with thy sheep:
Exod 22:30 ב: seven days it shall be with his dam;
Exod 22:30 ג: on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
Exod 22:31 א: And ye shall be holy men unto me:
Exod 22:31 ב: [any] flesh [that is] torn of beasts in the field;
Exod 22:31 ג: neither shall ye eat
Exod 22:31 ד: ye shall cast it to the dogs.
Exod 23:1 א: Thou shalt not raise a false report:
Exod 23:1 ב: put not thine hand with the wicked
Exod 23:1 ג: to be an unrighteous witness.
Exod 23:2 א: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to [do] evil;
Exod 23:2 ב: neither shalt thou speak in a cause
Exod 23:2 ג: to decline after many to wrest [judgment]:
Exod 23:3 א: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
Exod 23:4 א: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox
Exod 23:4 ב: or his ass going astray,
Exod 23:4 ג: thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
Exod 23:5 א: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee
Exod 23:5 ב: lying under his burden,
Exod 23:5 ג: and wouldest forbear to help him,
Exod 23:5 ד: thou shalt surely help with him.
Exod 23:6 א: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
Exod 23:7 א: Keep thee far from a false matter;
Exod 23:7 ב: and the innocent and righteous slay thou not:
Exod 23:7 ג: for I will not justify the wicked.
Exod 23:8 א: And thou shalt take no gift:
Exod 23:8 ב: for the gift blindeth the wise,
Exod 23:8 ג: and perverteth the words of the righteous.
Exod 23:9 א: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger:
Exod 23:9 ב: for ye know the heart of a stranger,
Exod 23:9 ג: seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
Exod 23:10 א: And six years thou shalt sow thy land,
Exod 23:10 ב: and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
Exod 23:11 א: But the seventh [year] thou shalt let it rest and lie still;
Exod 23:11 ב: that the poor of thy people may eat:
Exod 23:11 ג: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat.
Exod 23:11 ד: In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, [and] with thy oliveyard.
Exod 23:12 א: Six days thou shalt do thy work,
Exod 23:12 ב: and on the seventh day thou shalt rest:
Exod 23:12 ג: that thine ox and thine ass may rest,
Exod 23:12 ד: and the son of thy handmaid, [...] may be refreshed.
Exod 23:12 ה: and the stranger,
Exod 23:13 א: And in all [things] that I have said unto you
Exod 23:13 ב: be circumspect:
Exod 23:13 ג: and [...] of the name [...] other gods,
Exod 23:13 ד: make no mention [...] of
Exod 23:13 ה: neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
Exod 23:14 א: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
Exod 23:15 א: the feast of unleavened bread:
Exod 23:15 ב: Thou shalt keep [...] seven days,
Exod 23:15 ג: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread [...] as I commanded thee,
Exod 23:15 ד: in the time appointed of the month Abib;
Exod 23:15 ה: for in it thou camest out from Egypt:
Exod 23:15 ו: and none shall appear before me empty:)
Exod 23:16 א: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits
Exod 23:16 ב: of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field:
Exod 23:16 ג: and the feast of ingathering, [which is] in the end of the year,
Exod 23:16 ד: when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
Exod 23:17 א: Three times in the year
Exod 23:17 ב: all thy males shall appear
Exod 23:17 ג: before the Lord GOD.
Exod 23:18 א: Thou shalt not offer [...] with leavened bread;
Exod 23:18 ב: the blood of my sacrifice
Exod 23:18 ג: neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain
Exod 23:18 ד: until the morning.
Exod 23:19 א: The first of the firstfruits of thy land
Exod 23:19 ב: thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God.
Exod 23:19 ג: Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
Exod 23:20 א: Behold, I send an Angel before thee,
Exod 23:20 ב: to keep thee in the way,
Exod 23:20 ג: and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
Exod 23:21 א: Beware of him,
Exod 23:21 ב: and obey his voice,
Exod 23:21 ג: provoke him not;
Exod 23:21 ד: for he will not pardon your transgressions:
Exod 23:21 ה: for my name [is] in him.
Exod 23:22 א: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice,
Exod 23:22 ב: and do all that I speak;
Exod 23:22 ג: then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies,
Exod 23:22 ד: and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
Exod 23:23 א: For mine Angel shall go before thee,
Exod 23:23 ב: and bring thee in unto the Amorites,
Exod 23:23 ג: and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites,
Exod 23:23 ד: [and] the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
Exod 23:23 ה: and I will cut them off.
Exod 23:24 א: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods,
Exod 23:24 ב: nor serve them,
Exod 23:24 ג: nor do after their works:
Exod 23:24 ד: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them,
Exod 23:24 ה: and quite break down their images.
Exod 23:25 א: And ye shall serve the LORD your God,
Exod 23:25 ב: and he shall bless thy bread,
Exod 23:25 ג: and thy water;
Exod 23:25 ד: and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
Exod 23:26 א: There shall nothing cast their young,
Exod 23:26 ב: nor be barren, in thy land:
Exod 23:26 ג: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
Exod 23:27 א: I will send my fear before thee,
Exod 23:27 ב: and will destroy all the people
Exod 23:27 ג: to whom thou shalt come,
Exod 23:27 ד: and I will make all thine enemies
Exod 23:27 ה: turn their backs unto thee.
Exod 23:28 א: And I will send hornets before thee,
Exod 23:28 ב: which shall drive out the Hivite,
Exod 23:28 ג: the Canaanite,
Exod 23:28 ד: and the Hittite,
Exod 23:28 ה: from before thee.
Exod 23:29 א: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year;
Exod 23:29 ב: lest the land become desolate,
Exod 23:29 ג: and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
Exod 23:30 א: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee,
Exod 23:30 ב: until thou be increased,
Exod 23:30 ג: and inherit the land.
Exod 23:31 א: And I will set thy bounds
Exod 23:31 ב: from the Red sea
Exod 23:31 ג: even unto the sea of the Philistines,
Exod 23:31 ד: and from the desert
Exod 23:31 ה: unto the river:
Exod 23:31 ו: for I will deliver [...] into your hand;
Exod 23:31 ז: the inhabitants of the land
Exod 23:31 ח: and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
Exod 23:32 א: Thou shalt make no [...] with them,
Exod 23:32 ב: nor with their gods.
Exod 23:32 ג: covenant
Exod 23:33 א: They shall not dwell in thy land,
Exod 23:33 ב: lest they make thee sin against me:
Exod 23:33 ג: for if thou serve their gods,
Exod 23:33 ד: it will surely be a snare unto thee.
Exod 24:1 א: And he said unto Moses,
Exod 24:1 ב: Come up unto the LORD,
Exod 24:1 ג: thou, and Aaron,
Exod 24:1 ד: Nadab, and Abihu,
Exod 24:1 ה: and seventy of the elders of Israel;
Exod 24:1 ו: and worship ye afar off.
Exod 24:2 א: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD:
Exod 24:2 ב: but they shall not come nigh;
Exod 24:2 ג: neither shall the people go up with him.
Exod 24:3 א: And Moses came and told the people
Exod 24:3 ב: all the words of the LORD,
Exod 24:3 ג: and all the judgments:
Exod 24:3 ד: and all the people answered with one voice,
Exod 24:3 ה: and said,
Exod 24:3 ו: All the words which the LORD hath said
Exod 24:3 ז: will we do.
Exod 24:4 א: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD,
Exod 24:4 ב: and rose up early in the morning,
Exod 24:4 ג: and builded an altar under the hill,
Exod 24:4 ד: and twelve pillars,
Exod 24:4 ה: according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
Exod 24:5 א: And he sent young men of the children of Israel,
Exod 24:5 ב: which offered burnt offerings,
Exod 24:5 ג: and sacrificed [...] offerings
Exod 24:5 ד: peace [...] of oxen unto the LORD.
Exod 24:6 א: And Moses took half of the blood,
Exod 24:6 ב: and put [it] in basons;
Exod 24:6 ג: and half of the blood
Exod 24:6 ד: he sprinkled on the altar.
Exod 24:7 א: And he took the book of the covenant,
Exod 24:7 ב: and read in the audience of the people: and they said,
Exod 24:7 ג: All that the LORD hath said
Exod 24:7 ד: will we do, and be obedient.
Exod 24:8 א: And Moses took the blood,
Exod 24:8 ב: and sprinkled [it] on the people,
Exod 24:8 ג: and said, Behold
Exod 24:8 ד: the blood of the covenant,
Exod 24:8 ה: which the LORD hath made with you
Exod 24:8 ו: concerning all these words.
Exod 24:9 א: Then went up Moses, and Aaron,
Exod 24:9 ב: Nadab, and Abihu,
Exod 24:9 ג: and seventy of the elders of Israel:
Exod 24:10 א: And they saw the God of Israel:
Exod 24:10 ב: and [there was] under his feet
Exod 24:10 ג: as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone,
Exod 24:10 ד: and as it were the body of heaven in [his] clearness.
Exod 24:11 א: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel
Exod 24:11 ב: he laid not his hand:
Exod 24:11 ג: also they saw God,
Exod 24:11 ד: and did eat and drink.
Exod 24:12 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 24:12 ב: Come up to me into the mount,
Exod 24:12 ג: and be there:
Exod 24:12 ד: and I will give thee tables of stone,
Exod 24:12 ה: and a law,
Exod 24:12 ו: and commandments which I have written;
Exod 24:12 ז: that thou mayest teach them.
Exod 24:13 א: And Moses rose up,
Exod 24:13 ב: and his minister Joshua:
Exod 24:13 ג: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
Exod 24:14 א: And he said unto the elders,
Exod 24:14 ב: Tarry ye here for us,
Exod 24:14 ג: until we come again unto you:
Exod 24:14 ד: and, behold,
Exod 24:14 ה: Aaron and Hur [are] with you:
Exod 24:14 ו: if any man have any matters to do,
Exod 24:14 ז: let him come unto them.
Exod 24:15 א: And Moses went up into the mount,
Exod 24:15 ב: and a cloud covered the mount.
Exod 24:16 א: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai,
Exod 24:16 ב: and the cloud covered it six days:
Exod 24:16 ג: and [...] he called unto Moses
Exod 24:16 ד: the seventh day
Exod 24:16 ה: out of the midst of the cloud.
Exod 24:17 א: And the sight of the glory of the LORD
Exod 24:17 ב: [was] like devouring fire on the top of the mount
Exod 24:17 ג: in the eyes of the children of Israel.
Exod 24:18 א: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud,
Exod 24:18 ב: and gat him up into the mount:
Exod 24:18 ג: and Moses was in the mount
Exod 24:18 ד: forty days and forty nights.

Exod 25:2 ב: that they bring me an offering:

kjv: Exod 25:2 ג: of every man
Exod 25:2 ד: that giveth it willingly with his heart
Exod 25:2 ה: ye shall take my offering.

meaning: heave offering (for being lifted up unto)

kjv: Exod 25:3 א: And this [is] the offering which ye shall take of them;

meaning: heave offering (for being lifted up unto)

Exod 25:4 א: And blue, and purple, and scarlet,
Exod 25:4 ב: and fine linen, and goats’ [hair],
Exod 25:5 א: And rams’ skins dyed red,
Exod 25:5 ב: and badgers’ skins,
Exod 25:5 ג: and shittim wood,
Exod 25:6 א: Oil for the light,
Exod 25:6 ב: spices for anointing oil,
Exod 25:6 ג: and for sweet incense,
Exod 25:7 א: Onyx stones, and stones to be set
Exod 25:7 ב: in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
Exod 25:8 א: And let them make me a sanctuary;
Exod 25:8 ב: that I may dwell among them.
Exod 25:9 א: According to all that I shew thee,
Exod 25:9 ב: [after] the pattern of the tabernacle,
Exod 25:9 ג: and the pattern of all the instruments thereof,
Exod 25:9 ד: even so shall ye make [it].
Exod 25:10 א: And they shall make an ark [of] shittim wood:
Exod 25:10 ב: two cubits and a half [shall be] the length thereof,
Exod 25:10 ג: and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof,
Exod 25:10 ד: and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
Exod 25:11 א: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold,
Exod 25:11 ב: within and without shalt thou overlay it,
Exod 25:11 ג: and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
Exod 25:12 א: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it,
Exod 25:12 ב: and put [them] in the four corners thereof;

Exod 25:28 א: And thou shalt make the staves [of] shittim wood,

Exod 25:29 א: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof,

Exod 25:35 ב: and a knop under two branches of the same,
Exod 25:35 ג: and a knop under two branches of the same,

Exod 25:36 א: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same:

Exod 25:38 א: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof,

Exod 25:39 א: [Of] a talent of pure gold shall he make it,

Exod 25:40 א: And look that thou make [them] after their pattern,

Exod 26:8 ג: and the breadth [...] four cubits:

Exod 26:13 א: And a cubit on the one side,
Exod 26:13 ב: and a cubit on the other side

Exod 26:13 ה: on this side and on that side,
Exod 26:13 ו: to cover it.
Exod 26:14 א: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent
Exod 26:14 ב: [of] rams’ skins dyed red,
Exod 26:14 ג: and a covering [...] [of] badgers’ skins.
Exod 26:14 ד: above
Exod 26:15 א: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle
Exod 26:15 ב: [of] shittim wood standing up.
Exod 26:16 א: Ten cubits [shall be] the length of a board,
Exod 26:16 ב: and a cubit and a half
Exod 26:16 ג: [shall be] the breadth of one board.
Exod 26:17 א: Two tenons [shall there be] in one board,
Exod 26:17 ב: set in order one against another:
Exod 26:17 ג: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
Exod 26:18 א: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle,
Exod 26:18 ב: twenty boards on the south side southward.
Exod 26:19 א: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver
Exod 26:19 ב: under the twenty boards;
Exod 26:19 ג: two sockets under one board
Exod 26:19 ד: for his two tenons,
Exod 26:19 ה: and two sockets under another board
Exod 26:19 ו: for his two tenons.
Exod 26:20 א: And for the second side of the tabernacle
Exod 26:20 ב: on the north side
Exod 26:20 ג: [there shall be] twenty boards:
Exod 26:21 א: And their forty sockets [of] silver;
Exod 26:21 ב: two sockets under one board,
Exod 26:21 ג: and two sockets under another board.
Exod 26:22 א: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward
Exod 26:22 ב: thou shalt make six boards.
Exod 26:23 א: And two boards shalt thou make
Exod 26:23 ב: for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
Exod 26:24 א: And they shall be coupled together beneath,
Exod 26:24 ב: and they shall be coupled together
Exod 26:24 ג: above the head of it unto one ring:

Exod 26:24 ה: they shall be for the two corners.
Exod 26:25 א: And they shall be eight boards,
Exod 26:25 ב: and their sockets [of] silver,
Exod 26:25 ג: sixteen sockets;
Exod 26:25 ד: two sockets under one board,
Exod 26:25 ה: and two sockets under another board.
Exod 26:26 א: And thou shalt make bars [of] shittim wood;
Exod 26:26 ב: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
Exod 26:27 א: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle,
Exod 26:27 ב: and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle,
Exod 26:27 ג: for the two sides westward.
Exod 26:28 א: And the middle bar
Exod 26:28 ב: in the midst of the boards shall reach
Exod 26:28 ג: from end to end.
Exod 26:29 א: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold,
Exod 26:29 ב: and make their rings [of] gold
Exod 26:29 ג: [for] places for the bars:
Exod 26:29 ד: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
Exod 26:30 א: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle
Exod 26:30 ב: according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
Exod 26:31 א: And thou shalt make a vail [of] blue, and purple, and scarlet,
Exod 26:31 ב: and fine twined linen
Exod 26:31 ג: of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
Exod 26:32 א: And thou shalt hang it
Exod 26:32 ב: upon four pillars of shittim [wood]
Exod 26:32 ג: overlaid with gold:
Exod 26:32 ד: their hooks [shall be of] gold,
Exod 26:32 ה: upon the four sockets of silver.
Exod 26:33 א: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches,
Exod 26:33 ב: that thou mayest bring in thither
Exod 26:33 ג: within the vail
Exod 26:33 ד: the ark of the testimony:
Exod 26:33 ה: and the vail shall divide unto you
Exod 26:33 ו: between the holy [place]
Exod 26:33 ז: and the most holy.
Exod 26:34 א: And thou shalt put the mercy seat
Exod 26:34 ב: upon the ark of the testimony
Exod 26:34 ג: in the most holy [place].
Exod 26:35 א: And thou shalt set the table without the vail,
Exod 26:35 ב: and the candlestick over against the table
Exod 26:35 ג: on the side of the tabernacle toward the south:
Exod 26:35 ד: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
Exod 26:36 א: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent,
Exod 26:36 ב: [of] blue, and purple, and scarlet,
Exod 26:36 ג: and fine twined linen,
Exod 26:36 ד: wrought with needlework.
Exod 26:37 א: And thou shalt make for the hanging
Exod 26:37 ב: five pillars [of] shittim [wood],
Exod 26:37 ג: and overlay them with gold,
Exod 26:37 ד: [and] their hooks [shall be of] gold:
Exod 26:37 ה: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

Exod 27:21 ב: without the vail,
Exod 27:21 ג: which [is] before the testimony,

Exod 27:21 ה: from evening to morning
Exod 27:21 ו: before the LORD:

Exod 28:23 ב: two rings of gold,

Exod 28:25 ד: before it.

Exod 28:26 ב: and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate
Exod 28:26 ג: in the border thereof,
Exod 28:26 ד: which [is] in the side of the ephod
Exod 28:26 ה: inward.
Exod 28:27 א: And two [other] rings of gold thou shalt make,
Exod 28:27 ב: and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod

Exod 31:6 ה: I have put wisdom,
Exod 31:6 ו: that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
Exod 31:7 א: The tabernacle of the congregation,
Exod 31:7 ב: and the ark of the testimony,
Exod 31:7 ג: and the mercy seat that [is] thereupon,
Exod 31:7 ד: and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

Exod 31:8 ג: with all his furniture,

Exod 31:9 א: And the altar of burnt offering
Exod 31:9 ב: with all his furniture,
