Exod 31:9 ד: and his foot,
Exod 31:10 א: And the cloths of service,
Exod 31:10 ב: and the holy garments for Aaron the priest,
Exod 31:10 ג: and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,
Exod 31:11 א: And the anointing oil,
Exod 31:11 ב: and sweet incense for the holy [place]:
Exod 31:11 ג: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
Exod 31:12 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Exod 31:13 א: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying,
Exod 31:13 ב: Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep:
Exod 31:13 ג: for it [is] a sign
Exod 31:13 ד: between me and you throughout your generations;
Exod 31:13 ה: that [ye] may know that I [am] the LORD that doth sanctify you.
Exod 31:14 א: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore;
Exod 31:14 ב: for it [is] holy unto you:
Exod 31:14 ג: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death:
Exod 31:14 ד: for whosoever doeth [any] work therein,
Exod 31:14 ה: that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Exod 31:15 א: Six days may work be done;
Exod 31:15 ב: but in the seventh [is]
Exod 31:15 ג: the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD:
Exod 31:15 ד: whosoever doeth [any] work in the sabbath day,
Exod 31:15 ה: he shall surely be put to death.
Exod 31:16 א: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath,
Exod 31:16 ב: to observe the sabbath
Exod 31:16 ג: throughout their generations,
Exod 31:16 ד: [for] a perpetual covenant.
Exod 31:17 א: between me and the children of Israel
Exod 31:17 ב: It [is] a sign [...] for ever:
Exod 31:17 ג: for [in] six days the LORD made
Exod 31:17 ד: heaven and earth,
Exod 31:17 ה: and on the seventh day he rested,
Exod 31:17 ו: and was refreshed.
Exod 31:18 א: And he gave unto Moses,
Exod 31:18 ב: when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai,
Exod 31:18 ג: two tables of testimony,
Exod 31:18 ד: tables of stone,
Exod 31:18 ה: written with the finger of God.
Exod 32:1 א: And when the people saw that Moses delayed
Exod 32:1 ב: to come down out of the mount,
Exod 32:1 ג: the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron,
Exod 32:1 ד: and said unto him,
Exod 32:1 ה: Up,
Exod 32:1 ו: make us gods,
Exod 32:1 ז: which shall go before us;
Exod 32:1 ח: for [as for] this Moses,
Exod 32:1 ט: the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt,
Exod 32:1 י: we wot not what is become of him.
Exod 32:2 א: And Aaron said unto them,
Exod 32:2 ב: Break off the golden earrings,
Exod 32:2 ג: which [are] in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters,
Exod 32:2 ד: and bring [them] unto me.
Exod 32:3 א: And all the people brake off
Exod 32:3 ב: the golden earrings which [were] in their ears,
Exod 32:3 ג: and brought [them] unto Aaron.
Exod 32:4 א: And he received [them] at their hand,
Exod 32:4 ב: and fashioned it with a graving tool,
Exod 32:4 ג: after he had made it a molten calf:
Exod 32:4 ד: and they said,
Exod 32:4 ה: These [be] thy gods, O Israel,
Exod 32:4 ו: which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
Exod 32:5 א: And when Aaron saw [it],
Exod 32:5 ב: he built an altar before it;
Exod 32:5 ג: and Aaron made proclamation, and said,
Exod 32:5 ד: To morrow [is] a feast to the LORD.
Exod 32:6 א: And they rose up early on the morrow,
Exod 32:6 ב: and offered burnt offerings,
Exod 32:6 ג: and brought peace offerings;
Exod 32:6 ד: and the people sat down to eat and to drink,
Exod 32:6 ה: and rose up to play.
Exod 32:7 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 32:7 ב: Go, get thee down;
Exod 32:7 ג: for thy people, [...] have corrupted [themselves]:
Exod 32:7 ד: which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt,
Exod 32:8 א: They have turned aside quickly out of the way
Exod 32:8 ב: which I commanded them:
Exod 32:8 ג: they have made them a molten calf,
Exod 32:8 ד: and have worshipped it,
Exod 32:8 ה: and have sacrificed thereunto,
Exod 32:8 ו: and said,
Exod 32:8 ז: These [be] thy gods, O Israel,
Exod 32:8 ח: which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
Exod 32:9 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 32:9 ב: I have seen this people, and, behold,
Exod 32:9 ג: it [is] a stiffnecked people:
Exod 32:10 א: Now therefore let me alone,
Exod 32:10 ב: that my wrath may wax hot against them,
Exod 32:10 ג: and that I may consume them:
Exod 32:10 ד: and I will make of thee a great nation.
Exod 32:11 א: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said,
Exod 32:11 ב: LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people,
Exod 32:11 ג: which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt
Exod 32:11 ד: with great power, and with a mighty hand?
Exod 32:12 א: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say,
Exod 32:12 ב: For mischief did he bring them out,
Exod 32:12 ג: to slay them in the mountains,
Exod 32:12 ד: and to consume them from the face of the earth?
Exod 32:12 ה: Turn from thy fierce wrath,
Exod 32:12 ו: and repent of this evil against thy people.
Exod 32:13 א: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel,
Exod 32:13 ב: thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self,
Exod 32:13 ג: and saidst unto them,
Exod 32:13 ד: I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven,
Exod 32:13 ה: and all this land
Exod 32:13 ו: that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed,
Exod 32:13 ז: and they shall inherit [it] for ever.
Exod 32:14 א: And the LORD repented of the evil
Exod 32:14 ב: which he thought to do unto his people.
Exod 32:15 א: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount,
Exod 32:15 ב: and the two tables of the testimony [were] in his hand:
Exod 32:15 ג: the tables [were] written on both their sides;
Exod 32:15 ד: on the one side and on the other
Exod 32:15 ה: [were] they written.
Exod 32:16 א: And the tables [were] the work of God,
Exod 32:16 ב: and the writing [was] the writing of God,
Exod 32:16 ג: graven upon the tables.
Exod 32:17 א: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted,
Exod 32:17 ב: he said unto Moses,
Exod 32:17 ג: [There is] a noise of war in the camp.
Exod 32:18 א: And he said, [It is] not the voice of [them that] shout for mastery,
Exod 32:18 ב: neither [is it] the voice of [them that] cry for being overcome:
Exod 32:18 ג: [but] the noise of [them that] sing do I hear.
Exod 32:19 א: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp,
Exod 32:19 ב: that he saw the calf,
Exod 32:19 ג: and the dancing:
Exod 32:19 ד: and Moses’ anger waxed hot,
Exod 32:19 ה: and he cast the tables out of his hands,
Exod 32:19 ו: and brake them beneath the mount.
Exod 32:20 א: And he took the calf which they had made,
Exod 32:20 ב: and burnt [it] in the fire,
Exod 32:20 ג: and ground [it] to powder,
Exod 32:20 ד: and strawed [it] upon the water,
Exod 32:20 ה: and made the children of Israel drink [of it].
Exod 32:21 א: And Moses said unto Aaron,
Exod 32:21 ב: What did this people unto thee,
Exod 32:21 ג: that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
Exod 32:22 א: And Aaron said,
Exod 32:22 ב: Let not the anger of my lord wax hot:
Exod 32:22 ג: thou knowest the people,
Exod 32:22 ד: that they [are set] on mischief.
Exod 32:23 א: For they said unto me,
Exod 32:23 ב: Make us gods,
Exod 32:23 ג: which shall go before us:
Exod 32:23 ד: for [as for] this Moses,
Exod 32:23 ה: the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt,
Exod 32:23 ו: we wot not what is become of him.
Exod 32:24 א: And I said unto them,
Exod 32:24 ב: Whosoever hath any gold, let them break [it] off.
Exod 32:24 ג: So they gave [it] me:
Exod 32:24 ד: then I cast it into the fire,
Exod 32:24 ה: and there came out this calf.
Exod 32:25 א: And when Moses saw [...] the people
Exod 32:25 ב: that [...] [were] naked;
Exod 32:25 ג: (for Aaron had made them naked
Exod 32:25 ד: unto [their] shame among their enemies:)
Exod 32:26 א: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said,
Exod 32:26 ב: Who [is] on the LORD’S side? [let him come] unto me.
Exod 32:26 ג: And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
Exod 32:27 א: And he said unto them,
Exod 32:27 ב: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel,
Exod 32:27 ג: Put every man his sword by his side,
Exod 32:27 ד: [and] go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp,
Exod 32:27 ה: and slay every man his brother,
Exod 32:27 ו: and every man his companion,
Exod 32:27 ז: and every man his neighbour.
Exod 32:28 א: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses:
Exod 32:28 ב: and there fell of the people that day
Exod 32:28 ג: about three thousand men.
Exod 32:29 א: For Moses had said,
Exod 32:29 ב: Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD,
Exod 32:29 ג: even every man upon his son, and upon his brother;
Exod 32:29 ד: that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
Exod 32:30 א: And it came to pass on the morrow,
Exod 32:30 ב: that Moses said unto the people,
Exod 32:30 ג: Ye have sinned a great sin:
Exod 32:30 ד: and now I will go up unto the LORD;
Exod 32:30 ה: peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
Exod 32:31 א: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said,
Exod 32:31 ב: Oh,
Exod 32:31 ג: this people have sinned a great sin,
Exod 32:31 ד: and have made them gods of gold.
Exod 32:32 א: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin—;
Exod 32:32 ב: and if not,
Exod 32:32 ג: blot me, I pray thee,
Exod 32:32 ד: out of thy book which thou hast written.
Exod 32:33 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 32:33 ב: Whosoever hath sinned against me,
Exod 32:33 ג: him will I blot out of my book.
Exod 32:34 א: Therefore now go,
Exod 32:34 ב: lead the people
Exod 32:34 ג: unto [the place] of which I have spoken unto thee:
Exod 32:34 ד: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee:
Exod 32:34 ה: nevertheless in the day when I visit
Exod 32:34 ו: I will visit their sin upon them.
Exod 32:35 א: And the LORD plagued the people,
Exod 32:35 ב: because they made
Exod 32:35 ג: the calf, which Aaron made.
Exod 33:1 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 33:1 ב: Depart,
Exod 33:1 ג: [and] go up hence,
Exod 33:1 ד: thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt,
Exod 33:1 ה: unto the land which I sware
Exod 33:1 ו: unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying,
Exod 33:1 ז: Unto thy seed will I give it:
Exod 33:2 א: And I will send an angel before thee;
Exod 33:2 ב: and I will drive out the Canaanite,
Exod 33:2 ג: the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite,
Exod 33:2 ד: the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
Exod 33:3 א: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey:
Exod 33:3 ב: for I will not go up in the midst of thee;
Exod 33:3 ג: for thou [art] a stiffnecked people:
Exod 33:3 ד: lest I consume thee in the way.
Exod 33:4 א: And when the people heard these evil tidings,
Exod 33:4 ב: they mourned:
Exod 33:4 ג: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
Exod 33:5 א: For the LORD had said unto Moses,
Exod 33:5 ב: Say unto the children of Israel,
Exod 33:5 ג: Ye [are] a stiffnecked people:
Exod 33:5 ד: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee:
Exod 33:5 ה: therefore now
Exod 33:5 ו: put off thy ornaments from thee,
Exod 33:5 ז: that I may know what to do unto thee.
Exod 33:6 א: And [...] stripped themselves
Exod 33:6 ב: the children of Israel
Exod 33:6 ג: of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
Exod 33:7 א: And Moses took the tabernacle,
Exod 33:7 ב: and pitched it without the camp,
Exod 33:7 ג: afar off from the camp,
Exod 33:7 ד: and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation.
Exod 33:7 ה: And it came to pass, [that] every one which sought the LORD
Exod 33:7 ו: went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation,
Exod 33:7 ז: which [was] without the camp.
Exod 33:8 א: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle,
Exod 33:8 ב: [that] all the people rose up,
Exod 33:8 ג: and stood every man [at] his tent door,
Exod 33:8 ד: and looked after Moses,
Exod 33:8 ה: until he was gone into the tabernacle.
Exod 33:9 א: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle,
Exod 33:9 ב: the cloudy pillar descended,
Exod 33:9 ג: and stood [at] the door of the tabernacle,
Exod 33:9 ד: and [the LORD] talked with Moses.
Exod 33:10 א: And all the people saw
Exod 33:10 ב: the cloudy pillar
Exod 33:10 ג: stand [at] the tabernacle door:
Exod 33:10 ד: and all the people rose up
Exod 33:10 ה: and worshipped, every man [in] his tent door.
Exod 33:11 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses
Exod 33:11 ב: face to face,
Exod 33:11 ג: as a man speaketh unto his friend.
Exod 33:11 ד: And he turned again into the camp:
Exod 33:11 ה: but his servant Joshua,
Exod 33:11 ו: the son of Nun, a young man,
Exod 33:11 ז: departed not out of the tabernacle.
Exod 33:12 א: And Moses said unto the LORD,
Exod 33:12 ב: See, thou sayest unto me,
Exod 33:12 ג: Bring up this people:
Exod 33:12 ד: and thou hast not let me know
Exod 33:12 ה: whom thou wilt send with me.
Exod 33:12 ו: Yet thou hast said,
Exod 33:12 ז: I know thee by name,
Exod 33:12 ח: and [...] also
Exod 33:12 ט: thou hast [...] found grace in my sight.
Exod 33:13 א: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight,
Exod 33:13 ב: shew me now thy way,
Exod 33:13 ג: that I may know thee,
Exod 33:13 ד: that I may find grace in thy sight:
Exod 33:13 ה: and consider that [...] thy people.
Exod 33:13 ו: this nation [is]
Exod 33:14 א: And he said,
Exod 33:14 ב: My presence shall go [with thee],
Exod 33:14 ג: and I will give thee rest.
Exod 33:15 א: And he said unto him,
Exod 33:15 ב: If thy presence go not [with me],
Exod 33:15 ג: carry us not up hence.
Exod 33:16 א: For wherein shall it be known here
Exod 33:16 ב: that [...] have found grace in thy sight?
Exod 33:16 ג: I and thy people
Exod 33:16 ד: [is it] not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated,
Exod 33:16 ה: I and thy people,
Exod 33:16 ו: from all the people that [are] upon the face of the earth.
Exod 33:17 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 33:17 ב: this thing also that thou hast spoken:
Exod 33:17 ג: I will do
Exod 33:17 ד: for thou hast found grace in my sight,
Exod 33:17 ה: and I know thee by name.
Exod 33:18 א: And he said,
Exod 33:18 ב: I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
Exod 33:19 א: And he said,
Exod 33:19 ב: I will make all my goodness pass before thee,
Exod 33:19 ג: and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee;
Exod 33:19 ד: and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious,
Exod 33:19 ה: and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
Exod 33:20 א: And he said,
Exod 33:20 ב: Thou canst not see my face:
Exod 33:20 ג: for there shall no man see me,
Exod 33:20 ד: and live.
Exod 33:21 א: And the LORD said,
Exod 33:21 ב: Behold, [there is] a place by me,
Exod 33:21 ג: and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
Exod 33:22 א: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by,
Exod 33:22 ב: that I will put thee in a clift of the rock,
Exod 33:22 ג: and will cover thee with my hand
Exod 33:22 ד: while I pass by:
Exod 33:23 א: And I will take away mine hand,
Exod 33:23 ב: and thou shalt see my back parts:
Exod 33:23 ג: but my face shall not be seen.
Exod 34:1 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 34:1 ב: Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first:
Exod 34:1 ג: and I will write upon [these] tables
Exod 34:1 ד: the words that were in the first tables,
Exod 34:1 ה: which thou brakest.
Exod 34:2 א: And be ready in the morning,
Exod 34:2 ב: and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai,
Exod 34:2 ג: and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
Exod 34:3 א: And no man shall come up with thee,
Exod 34:3 ב: neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount;
Exod 34:3 ג: neither [...] the flocks nor herds
Exod 34:3 ד: let [...] feed before that mount.
Exod 34:4 א: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first;
Exod 34:4 ב: and Moses rose up early in the morning,
Exod 34:4 ג: and went up unto mount Sinai,
Exod 34:4 ד: as the LORD had commanded him,
Exod 34:4 ה: and took in his hand
Exod 34:4 ו: the two tables of stone.
Exod 34:5 א: And the LORD descended in the cloud,
Exod 34:5 ב: and stood with him there,
Exod 34:5 ג: and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
Exod 34:6 א: And the LORD passed by before him,
Exod 34:6 ב: and proclaimed, The LORD,
Exod 34:6 ג: The LORD God, merciful
Exod 34:6 ד: and gracious,
Exod 34:6 ה: longsuffering,
Exod 34:6 ו: and abundant in goodness
Exod 34:6 ז: and truth,
Exod 34:7 א: Keeping mercy for thousands,
Exod 34:7 ב: forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin,
Exod 34:7 ג: and that will by no means clear [the guilty];
Exod 34:7 ד: visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children,
Exod 34:7 ה: and upon the children’s children,
Exod 34:7 ו: unto the third
Exod 34:7 ז: and to the fourth [generation].
Exod 34:8 א: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth,
Exod 34:8 ב: and worshipped.
Exod 34:9 א: And he said,
Exod 34:9 ב: If now I have found grace in thy sight, [...] my Lord,
Exod 34:9 ג: O Lord, let [...] I pray thee, go among us;
Exod 34:9 ד: for it [is] a stiffnecked people;
Exod 34:9 ה: and pardon our iniquity and our sin,
Exod 34:9 ו: and take us for thine inheritance.
Exod 34:10 א: And he said, Behold,
Exod 34:10 ב: I make a covenant: before all thy people
Exod 34:10 ג: I will do marvels,
Exod 34:10 ד: such as have not been done in all the earth,
Exod 34:10 ה: nor in any nation:
Exod 34:10 ו: and all the people [...] shall see
Exod 34:10 ז: among which thou [art]
Exod 34:10 ח: the work of the LORD:
Exod 34:10 ט: for it [is] a terrible thing
Exod 34:10 י: that I will do with thee.
Exod 34:11 א: Observe thou
Exod 34:11 ב: that which I command thee this day:
Exod 34:11 ג: behold, I drive out before thee
Exod 34:11 ד: the Amorite,
Exod 34:11 ה: and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
Exod 34:12 א: Take heed to thyself,
Exod 34:12 ב: lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land
Exod 34:12 ג: whither thou goest,
Exod 34:12 ד: lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
Exod 34:13 א: But ye shall destroy their altars,
Exod 34:13 ב: break their images,
Exod 34:13 ג: and cut down their groves:
Exod 34:14 א: For thou shalt worship no other god:
Exod 34:14 ב: for the LORD, whose name [is] Jealous,
Exod 34:14 ג: [is] a jealous God:
Exod 34:15 א: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land,
Exod 34:15 ב: and they go a whoring after their gods,
Exod 34:15 ג: and do sacrifice unto their gods,
Exod 34:15 ד: and [one] call thee,
Exod 34:15 ה: and thou eat of his sacrifice;
Exod 34:16 א: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons,
Exod 34:16 ב: and their daughters go a whoring after their gods,
Exod 34:16 ג: and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
Exod 34:17 א: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
Exod 34:18 א: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep.
Exod 34:18 ב: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread,
Exod 34:18 ג: as I commanded thee,
Exod 34:18 ד: in the time of the month Abib:
Exod 34:18 ה: for in the month Abib
Exod 34:18 ו: thou camest out from Egypt.
Exod 34:19 א: All that openeth the matrix [is] mine;
Exod 34:19 ב: and every firstling among thy cattle,
Exod 34:19 ג: [whether] ox or sheep, [that is male].
Exod 34:20 א: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb:
Exod 34:20 ב: and if thou redeem [him] not,
Exod 34:20 ג: then shalt thou break his neck.
Exod 34:20 ד: All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem.
Exod 34:20 ה: And none shall appear before me empty.
Exod 34:21 א: Six days thou shalt work,
Exod 34:21 ב: but on the seventh day thou shalt rest:
Exod 34:21 ג: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
Exod 34:22 א: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks,
Exod 34:22 ב: of the firstfruits of wheat harvest,
Exod 34:22 ג: and the feast of ingathering
Exod 34:22 ד: at the year’s end.
Exod 34:23 א: Thrice in the year
Exod 34:23 ב: shall all your men children appear
Exod 34:23 ג: before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
Exod 34:24 א: For I will cast out the nations before thee,
Exod 34:24 ב: and enlarge thy borders:
Exod 34:24 ג: neither shall any man desire thy land,
Exod 34:24 ד: when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God
Exod 34:24 ה: thrice in the year.
Exod 34:25 א: Thou shalt not offer [...] with leaven;
Exod 34:25 ב: the blood of my sacrifice
Exod 34:25 ג: neither shall [...] be left unto the morning.
Exod 34:25 ד: the sacrifice of the feast of the passover
Exod 34:26 א: The first of the firstfruits of thy land
Exod 34:26 ב: thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God.
Exod 34:26 ג: Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
Exod 34:27 א: And the LORD said unto Moses,
Exod 34:27 ב: Write thou these words:
Exod 34:27 ג: for after the tenor of these words
Exod 34:27 ד: I have made a covenant with thee
Exod 34:27 ה: and with Israel.
Exod 34:28 א: And he was there with the LORD
Exod 34:28 ב: forty days and forty nights;
Exod 34:28 ג: he did neither eat bread,
Exod 34:28 ד: nor drink water.
Exod 34:28 ה: And he wrote upon the tables
Exod 34:28 ו: of the covenant, [...] commandments.
Exod 34:28 ז: the words [...] the ten
Exod 34:29 א: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai
Exod 34:29 ב: with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand,

Lev 25:50 ג: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years,
Lev 25:50 ד: according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
Lev 25:51 א: If [there be] yet many years [behind], according unto them
Lev 25:51 ב: he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
Lev 25:52 א: And if there remain but few years
Lev 25:52 ב: unto the year of jubile,
Lev 25:52 ג: then he shall count with him,
Lev 25:52 ד: [and] according unto his years shall he give him again
Lev 25:52 ה: the price of his redemption.
Lev 25:53 א: [And] as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him:
Lev 25:53 ב: [and the other] shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
Lev 25:54 א: And if he be not redeemed in these [years],
Lev 25:54 ב: then he shall go out in the year of jubile,
Lev 25:54 ג: [both] he, and his children with him.
Lev 25:55 א: For unto me the children of Israel [are] servants;
Lev 25:55 ב: they [are] my servants
Lev 25:55 ג: whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt:
Lev 25:55 ד: I [am] the LORD your God.
Lev 26:1 א: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image,
Lev 26:1 ב: neither rear you up a standing image,
Lev 26:1 ג: neither shall ye set up [any] image of stone in your land,
Lev 26:1 ד: to bow down unto it:
Lev 26:1 ה: for I [am] the LORD your God.
Lev 26:2 א: Ye shall keep my sabbaths,
Lev 26:2 ב: and reverence my sanctuary:
Lev 26:2 ג: I [am] the LORD.
Lev 26:3 א: If ye walk in my statutes,
Lev 26:3 ב: and keep my commandments,
Lev 26:3 ג: and do them;
Lev 26:4 א: Then I will give you rain in due season,
Lev 26:4 ב: and the land shall yield her increase,
Lev 26:4 ג: and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
Lev 26:5 א: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage,
Lev 26:5 ב: and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time:
Lev 26:5 ג: and ye shall eat your bread to the full,
Lev 26:5 ד: and dwell in your land safely.
Lev 26:6 א: And I will give peace in the land,
Lev 26:6 ב: and ye shall lie down, and none shall make [you] afraid:
Lev 26:6 ג: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land,
Lev 26:6 ד: neither shall the sword go through your land.
Lev 26:7 א: And ye shall chase your enemies,
Lev 26:7 ב: and they shall fall before you by the sword.
Lev 26:8 א: And five of you shall chase
Lev 26:8 ב: an hundred,
Lev 26:8 ג: and an hundred of you
Lev 26:8 ד: shall put ten thousand to flight:
Lev 26:8 ה: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
Lev 26:9 א: For I will have respect unto you,
Lev 26:9 ב: and make you fruitful,
Lev 26:9 ג: and multiply you,
Lev 26:9 ד: and establish my covenant with you.
Lev 26:10 א: And ye shall eat old store,
Lev 26:10 ב: and [...] the old because of the new.
Lev 26:10 ג: bring forth
Lev 26:11 א: And I will set my tabernacle among you:
Lev 26:11 ב: and my soul shall not abhor you.
Lev 26:12 א: And I will walk among you,
Lev 26:12 ב: and will be your God,
Lev 26:12 ג: and ye shall be my people.
Lev 26:13 א: I [am] the LORD your God,
Lev 26:13 ב: which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt,
Lev 26:13 ג: that ye should not be their bondmen;
Lev 26:13 ד: and I have broken the bands of your yoke,
Lev 26:13 ה: and made you go upright.
Lev 26:14 א: But if ye will not hearken unto me,
Lev 26:14 ב: and will not do all these commandments;
Lev 26:15 א: And if ye shall despise my statutes,
Lev 26:15 ב: or if your soul abhor my judgments,
Lev 26:15 ג: so that ye will not do all my commandments,
Lev 26:15 ד: [but] that ye break my covenant:
Lev 26:16 א: I also will do this unto you;
Lev 26:16 ב: I will even appoint over you terror,
Lev 26:16 ג: consumption,
Lev 26:16 ד: and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes,
Lev 26:16 ה: and cause sorrow of heart:
Lev 26:16 ו: and ye shall sow your seed in vain,
Lev 26:16 ז: for your enemies shall eat it.
Lev 26:17 א: And I will set my face against you,
Lev 26:17 ב: and ye shall be slain before your enemies:
Lev 26:17 ג: they that hate you shall reign over you;
Lev 26:17 ד: and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
Lev 26:18 א: And if [...] yet for all this
Lev 26:18 ב: ye will not [...] hearken unto me,
Lev 26:18 ג: then I will punish you [...] more
Lev 26:18 ד: seven times [...] for your sins.
Lev 26:19 א: And I will break the pride of your power;
Lev 26:19 ב: and I will make your heaven as iron,
Lev 26:19 ג: and your earth as brass:
Lev 26:20 א: And your strength shall be spent in vain:
Lev 26:20 ב: for your land shall not yield her increase,
Lev 26:20 ג: neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
Lev 26:21 א: And if ye walk contrary unto me,
Lev 26:21 ב: and will not hearken unto me;
Lev 26:21 ג: I will bring [...] more plagues upon you
Lev 26:21 ד: seven times [...] according to your sins.
Lev 26:22 א: I will also send wild beasts among you,
Lev 26:22 ב: which shall rob you of your children,
Lev 26:22 ג: and destroy your cattle,
Lev 26:22 ד: and make you few in number;
Lev 26:22 ה: and your [high] ways shall be desolate.
Lev 26:23 א: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things,
Lev 26:23 ב: but will walk contrary unto me;
Lev 26:24 א: Then will I also walk contrary unto you,
Lev 26:24 ב: and will punish you yet
Lev 26:24 ג: seven times for your sins.
Lev 26:25 א: And I will bring a sword upon you,
Lev 26:25 ב: that shall avenge the quarrel of [my] covenant:
Lev 26:25 ג: when ye are gathered together within your cities,
Lev 26:25 ד: and [...] I will send the pestilence among you;
Lev 26:25 ה: and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
Lev 26:26 א: [And] when I have broken the staff of your bread,
Lev 26:26 ב: ten women shall bake your bread
Lev 26:26 ג: in one oven,
Lev 26:26 ד: and they shall deliver [you] your bread again by weight:
Lev 26:26 ה: and ye shall eat,
Lev 26:26 ו: and not be satisfied.
Lev 26:27 א: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me,
Lev 26:27 ב: but walk contrary unto me;
Lev 26:28 א: Then I will walk contrary unto you [...] in fury;
Lev 26:28 ב: also [...] and I, even I, will chastise you
Lev 26:28 ג: seven times for your sins.
Lev 26:29 א: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons,
Lev 26:29 ב: and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
Lev 26:30 א: And I will destroy your high places,
Lev 26:30 ב: and cut down your images,
Lev 26:30 ג: and cast your carcases
Lev 26:30 ד: upon the carcases of your idols,
Lev 26:30 ה: and my soul shall abhor you.
Lev 26:31 א: And I will make your cities waste,
Lev 26:31 ב: and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation,
Lev 26:31 ג: and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
Lev 26:32 א: And I will bring the land into desolation:
Lev 26:32 ב: and your enemies [...] shall be astonished at it.
Lev 26:32 ג: which dwell therein
Lev 26:33 א: And I will scatter you among the heathen,
Lev 26:33 ב: and will draw out a sword after you:
Lev 26:33 ג: and your land shall be desolate,
Lev 26:33 ד: and your cities waste.
Lev 26:34 א: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths,
Lev 26:34 ב: as long as it lieth desolate,
Lev 26:34 ג: and ye [be] in your enemies’ land;
Lev 26:34 ד: [even] then shall the land rest,
Lev 26:34 ה: and enjoy her sabbaths.
Lev 26:35 א: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest;
Lev 26:35 ב: because it did not rest in your sabbaths,
Lev 26:35 ג: when ye dwelt upon it.
Lev 26:36 א: And upon them that are left [alive] of you
Lev 26:36 ב: I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies;
Lev 26:36 ג: and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them;
Lev 26:36 ד: and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword;
Lev 26:36 ה: and they shall fall when none pursueth.
Lev 26:37 א: And they shall fall one upon another,
Lev 26:37 ב: as it were before a sword,
Lev 26:37 ג: when none pursueth:
Lev 26:37 ד: and ye shall have no power to stand
Lev 26:37 ה: before your enemies.
Lev 26:38 א: And ye shall perish among the heathen,
Lev 26:38 ב: and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
Lev 26:39 א: And they that are left of you
Lev 26:39 ב: shall pine away in their iniquity
Lev 26:39 ג: in your enemies’ lands;
Lev 26:39 ד: and also in the iniquities of their fathers
Lev 26:39 ה: shall they pine away with them.
Lev 26:40 א: If they shall confess their iniquity,
Lev 26:40 ב: and the iniquity of their fathers,
Lev 26:40 ג: with their trespass which they trespassed against me,
Lev 26:40 ד: and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
Lev 26:41 א: And [that] I also have walked contrary unto them,
Lev 26:41 ב: and have brought them into the land of their enemies;
Lev 26:41 ג: if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled,
Lev 26:41 ד: and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
Lev 26:42 א: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob,
Lev 26:42 ב: and also my covenant with Isaac,
Lev 26:42 ג: and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember;
Lev 26:42 ד: and I will remember the land.
Lev 26:43 א: The land also shall be left of them,
Lev 26:43 ב: and shall enjoy her sabbaths,
Lev 26:43 ג: while she lieth desolate without them:
Lev 26:43 ד: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
Lev 26:43 ה: because, even because
Lev 26:43 ו: they despised my judgments,
Lev 26:43 ז: and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
Lev 26:44 א: And yet for all that, when
Lev 26:44 ב: they be in the land of their enemies,
Lev 26:44 ג: I will not cast them away,
Lev 26:44 ד: neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly,
Lev 26:44 ה: and to break my covenant with them:
Lev 26:44 ו: for I [am] the LORD their God.
Lev 26:45 א: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors,
Lev 26:45 ב: whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt
Lev 26:45 ג: in the sight of the heathen,
Lev 26:45 ד: that I might be their God:
Lev 26:45 ה: I [am] the LORD.
Lev 26:46 א: These [are] the statutes and judgments and laws,
Lev 26:46 ב: which the LORD made
Lev 26:46 ג: between him and the children of Israel
Lev 26:46 ד: in mount Sinai
Lev 26:46 ה: by the hand of Moses.
Lev 27:1 א: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Lev 27:2 א: Speak unto the children of Israel,
Lev 27:2 ב: and say unto them,
Lev 27:2 ג: When a man shall make a singular vow,
Lev 27:2 ד: the persons [shall be] for the LORD by thy estimation.
Lev 27:3 א: And thy estimation shall be of the male
Lev 27:3 ב: from twenty years old
Lev 27:3 ג: even unto sixty years old,
Lev 27:3 ד: even thy estimation shall be
Lev 27:3 ה: fifty shekels of silver,
Lev 27:3 ו: after the shekel of the sanctuary.
Lev 27:4 א: And if it [be] a female,
Lev 27:4 ב: then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
Lev 27:5 א: And if [it be] from five years old
Lev 27:5 ב: even unto twenty years old,
Lev 27:5 ג: then thy estimation shall be of the male
Lev 27:5 ד: twenty shekels,
Lev 27:5 ה: and for the female
Lev 27:5 ו: ten shekels.
Lev 27:6 א: And if [it be] from a month old
Lev 27:6 ב: even unto five years old,
Lev 27:6 ג: then thy estimation shall be of the male
Lev 27:6 ד: five shekels of silver,
Lev 27:6 ה: and for the female thy estimation [shall be]
Lev 27:6 ו: three shekels of silver.
Lev 27:7 א: And if [it be] from sixty years old and above;
Lev 27:7 ב: if [it be] a male,
Lev 27:7 ג: then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels,
Lev 27:7 ד: and for the female
Lev 27:7 ה: ten shekels.
Lev 27:8 א: But if he be poorer than thy estimation,
Lev 27:8 ב: then he shall present himself before the priest,
Lev 27:8 ג: and the priest shall value him;
Lev 27:8 ד: according to his ability that vowed
Lev 27:8 ה: shall the priest value him.
Lev 27:9 א: And if [it be] a beast, whereof men bring
Lev 27:9 ב: an offering unto the LORD,
Lev 27:9 ג: all that [any man] giveth of such
Lev 27:9 ד: unto the LORD shall be holy.
Lev 27:10 א: He shall not alter it,
Lev 27:10 ב: nor change it,
Lev 27:10 ג: a good for a bad, or a bad for a good:
Lev 27:10 ד: and if he shall at all change beast for beast,
Lev 27:10 ה: then
Lev 27:10 ו: it and the exchange thereof
Lev 27:10 ז: shall be holy.
Lev 27:11 א: And if [it be] any unclean beast,
Lev 27:11 ב: of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD,
Lev 27:11 ג: then he shall present the beast before the priest:
Lev 27:12 א: And the priest shall value it,
Lev 27:12 ב: whether it be good or bad:
Lev 27:12 ג: as thou valuest it, [who art] the priest,
Lev 27:12 ד: so shall it be.
Lev 27:13 א: But if he will at all redeem it,
Lev 27:13 ב: then he shall add a fifth [part] thereof unto thy estimation.
Lev 27:14 א: And when a man shall sanctify his house
Lev 27:14 ב: [to be] holy unto the LORD,
Lev 27:14 ג: then the priest shall estimate it,
Lev 27:14 ד: whether it be good or bad:
Lev 27:14 ה: as the priest shall estimate it,
Lev 27:14 ו: so shall it stand.
Lev 27:15 א: And if he that sanctified it
Lev 27:15 ב: will redeem his house,
Lev 27:15 ג: then he shall add the fifth [part] of the money of thy estimation unto it,
Lev 27:15 ד: and it shall be his.
Lev 27:16 א: And if [...] [some part] of a field of his possession,
Lev 27:16 ב: a man shall sanctify unto the LORD
Lev 27:16 ג: then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof:
Lev 27:16 ד: an homer of barley seed [shall be valued]
Lev 27:16 ה: at fifty shekels of silver.
Lev 27:17 א: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile,
Lev 27:17 ב: according to thy estimation it shall stand.
Lev 27:18 א: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile,
Lev 27:18 ב: then the priest shall reckon unto him
Lev 27:18 ג: the money according to the years that remain,
Lev 27:18 ד: even unto the year of the jubile,
Lev 27:18 ה: and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
Lev 27:19 א: And if [...] the field will in any wise redeem
Lev 27:19 ב: he that sanctified [...] it,
Lev 27:19 ג: then he shall add the fifth [part] of the money of thy estimation unto it,
Lev 27:19 ד: and it shall be assured to him.
Lev 27:20 א: And if he will not redeem the field,
Lev 27:20 ב: or if he have sold the field to another man,
Lev 27:20 ג: it shall not be redeemed any more.
Lev 27:21 א: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be
Lev 27:21 ב: holy unto the LORD,
Lev 27:21 ג: as a field devoted;
Lev 27:21 ד: the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.
Lev 27:22 א: And if [...] a field which he hath bought,
Lev 27:22 ב: which [is] not of the fields of his possession;
Lev 27:22 ג: [a man] sanctify unto the LORD
Lev 27:23 א: Then the priest shall reckon unto him
Lev 27:23 ב: the worth of thy estimation,
Lev 27:23 ג: [even] unto the year of the jubile:
Lev 27:23 ד: and he shall give thine estimation in that day,
Lev 27:23 ה: [as] a holy thing unto the LORD.
Lev 27:24 א: In the year of the jubile
Lev 27:24 ב: the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought,
Lev 27:24 ג: [even] to him to whom [...] [did belong].
Lev 27:24 ד: the possession of the land
Lev 27:25 א: And all thy estimations
Lev 27:25 ב: shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary:
Lev 27:25 ג: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
Lev 27:26 א: Only the firstling [...] which should be [...] firstling,
Lev 27:26 ב: of the beasts, [...] the LORD’S
Lev 27:26 ג: no man shall sanctify it;
Lev 27:26 ד: whether [it be] ox, or sheep:
Lev 27:26 ה: it [is] the LORD’S.
Lev 27:27 א: And if [it be] of an unclean beast,
Lev 27:27 ב: then he shall redeem [it] according to thine estimation,
Lev 27:27 ג: and shall add a fifth [part] of it thereto:
Lev 27:27 ד: or if it be not redeemed,
Lev 27:27 ה: then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
Lev 27:28 א: Notwithstanding no devoted thing,
Lev 27:28 ב: that a man shall devote unto the LORD
Lev 27:28 ג: of all that he hath,
Lev 27:28 ד: [both] of man and beast, and of the field of his possession,
Lev 27:28 ה: shall be sold
Lev 27:28 ו: or redeemed:
Lev 27:28 ז: every devoted thing
Lev 27:28 ח: [is] most holy unto the LORD.
Lev 27:29 א: devoted,
Lev 27:29 ב: which shall be devoted of men,
Lev 27:29 ג: None [...] shall be redeemed;
Lev 27:29 ד: [but] shall surely be put to death.
Lev 27:30 א: And all the tithe of the land,
Lev 27:30 ב: [whether] of the seed of the land,
Lev 27:30 ג: [or] of the fruit of the tree,
Lev 27:30 ד: [is] the LORD’S:
Lev 27:30 ה: [it is] holy unto the LORD.
Lev 27:31 א: And if a man will at all redeem [ought] of his tithes,
Lev 27:31 ב: he shall add thereto the fifth [part] thereof.
Lev 27:32 א: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock,
Lev 27:32 ב: [even] of whatsoever passeth under the rod,
Lev 27:32 ג: the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
Lev 27:33 א: He shall not search whether it be good or bad,
Lev 27:33 ב: neither shall he change it:
Lev 27:33 ג: and if he change it at all,
Lev 27:33 ד: then
Lev 27:33 ה: both it and the change thereof
Lev 27:33 ו: shall be holy;
Lev 27:33 ז: it shall not be redeemed.
Lev 27:34 א: These [are] the commandments,
Lev 27:34 ב: which the LORD commanded Moses
Lev 27:34 ג: for the children of Israel
Lev 27:34 ד: in mount Sinai.
